jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Within Microsoft’s CASQ organization, our team focuses on Copilot Chat quality and job completion. We turn advances in generative AI into improvements users can experience in their everyday work. The gap between what models can demonstrate and what users can consistently accomplish is where this role operates.

We’re hiring a **Principal Product Manager** to help close that gap. You’ll have room to identify new opportunities, shape product bets, and see them through to impact. The problems won’t always arrive neatly defined. Creating clarity is part of the job.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Identify where users struggle to complete jobs in Copilot Chat. Set product priorities and success criteria to improve chat quality and job completion against team goals.
* Turn emerging GenAI capabilities into product bets with engineering, applied science, and design. Test across the full conversation journey, from understanding intent to completing the task or helping users recover when it cannot.
* Ship, measure, and iterate. Establish whether evaluation gains translate into better job completion and business impact, then use that evidence to scale, refine, or stop a bet.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a strong GenAI portfolio built over the last few years. AI-native in practice: stays ahead of new capabilities and demonstrates what they can do through working products and prototypes.

* A proven record of shipping new bets and following through to measurable business impact, not stopping at a demo or launch.

* Someone who thrives in ambiguity and treats it as a feature, not a bug. Creates clarity, brings people along, and finds a path to ship. Uses fast learning and iteration to mitigate risk, with sound data judgment and cross-functional influence.

**Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Plane**
===============

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 63,000+ stars, 6,500+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

**Humans and agents**
---------------------

We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.

Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.

This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

**About the role**
------------------

Plane ships one product to three very different buyers: a team that signs up on Cloud in a minute, an organization that runs it on its own infrastructure, and one that runs it on machines with no internet connection. The same release has to be explained to all three, and the differences between what each one gets are real. You own the messaging system underneath that: what we claim for Projects, Wiki, Intake, and Plane AI, the proof behind each claim, and how a launch reaches the site, the docs, Sales, and the community as one story rather than three. You will work with product managers on what shipped, with Sales on the objections that decide enterprise deals, and with the community, who file an issue when a marketing page overstates the product.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own positioning for Projects, Wiki, Intake, and Plane AI, and the source of truth for every claim and the proof behind it. When someone asks whether we can say something, you decide.
* Own how capability maps to edition and tier. Cloud, self-hosted commercial, and air-gapped customers get different things, and the page has to say which.
* Lead launches end to end: narrative, plan, page, announcement, email, in-product copy, and enablement, closed out with a review that names what moved and changes the next launch.
* Own the product, solution, industry, and comparison pages. These get read mid-evaluation against Jira, Asana, Monday.com, and ClickUp by people who use the competitor daily.
* Run the research the positioning rests on: customer and prospect interviews, lost-deal reasons, community threads, and competitive moves, turned into language we can publish.
* Work weekly with product managers, design, Sales, and the community team, and take contested claims to the engineer who built the feature before they ship.
* Maintain the library that goes stale on its own: battlecards, edition explainers, demo scripts, and FAQs. Check claims against the docs one page at a time before every launch, because an overstated claim returns as a support ticket or a lost deal.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* **You have owned positioning that changed results.** You can name the product, the claim you changed, and what moved after: adoption, conversion, or win rate.
* **You ship the copy, not only the brief.** Web-ready pages and launch assets that went live under your name.
* **You have run launches across functions.** You have held a date with product, design, Sales, and support attached to it, and you can describe one that went badly and what you changed.
* **You can hold your own with technical audiences and enterprise buyers.** You have written for developers and IT without distorting the product, and sat in evaluations where security and deployment decided the outcome.
* **You work from evidence.** Customer interviews, sales calls, and product data, used to settle positioning arguments.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------

* You have marketed an open-source or open-core product, where the community reads the code and corrects the page.
* You have shipped multi-edition software where capability differs by deployment.
* You have written security, compliance, and deployment narratives: SSO, audit…

jobs.description:
Job Overview 综述:

Celanese, a Fortune 500 global chemical innovation company, engineers and manufactures chemicals essential to everyday living. Headquartered in Dallas, TX, we employ over 13,000 dedicated people across 50 facilities in 27 countries. We are committed to employee growth and creating shareholder value to ensure continued opportunities to make a difference.

Celanese is dedicated to creating exceptional digital experiences for our users. We are looking for a UX/UI Designer to design intuitive and visually appealing interfaces for our digital products. You will be responsible for creating user-centered designs for digital products such as websites, mobile apps, and software interfaces. Your primary focus is enhancing user satisfaction and usability by improving the accessibility, efficiency, and aesthetics of the product.

Responsibilities 职责:

* Gathering insights into user needs and preferences through interviews, surveys, and usability testing.
* Develop and implement innovative methods to improve the end-to-end user experience for our applications and systems.
* Create user personas, journey maps, wireframes, and prototypes to communicate design ideas effectively.
* Develop UI mockups and prototypes that clearly illustrate how sites function and look.
* Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate on designs and improve user satisfaction. This may include A/B testing and heuristic analysis.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers and marketers to ensure a seamless user experience.
* Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in user experience design and technology.
* Advocate for user-centered design principles and practices within Celanese.
* Identify and troubleshoot UX problems (e.g., responsiveness).
* Standardize the measurement of customer satisfaction across multiple applications.

Qualifications 要求:

* Minimum of 3 years of hands-on UX/UI experience in researching, designing, developing, and implementing solutions.
* Strong portfolio showcasing your UX/UI design skills and innovative solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Psychology, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related field.
* Knowledge of usability principles and techniques.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of articulating complex concepts and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive projects to completion.
* Strong creative, technical, and problem-solving skills with a solid understanding of graphic design and web technologies.
* Experience with programming languages such as HTML, CSS or JavaScript.

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Global Operations, Sales Tools & Technologies Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**A) Who You’ll Work With**
===========================

On our team, we build and run the systems that help Teradata’s sellers, marketers, services teams, and partners win and serve customers. Salesforce is the system of record for our go-to-market engine, spanning accounts, opportunities, pipeline, forecasting, quoting, and customer engagement. You will own that platform as a product.

You will partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations and Revenue Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Global Services, Finance, Legal and Privacy, and Technology Services platform administrators and developers. You will also work alongside other product owners on the Business Technology team to keep Salesforce integrated with the broader systems landscape, including Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, marketing automation, and learning systems. This position reports to the Senior Manager, Business Technology.

**B) What You’ll Do**
=====================

As the Salesforce Product Owner, you will translate business and user needs into clear, prioritized requirements, guide delivery in an agile model, and measure whether the platform is improving how Teradata sells and serves. Success means a Salesforce environment that is reliable, easy to use, well governed, and visibly tied to revenue and productivity outcomes.

Key responsibilities:

* Support the execution of the Salesforce product roadmap and backlog, prioritizing features, enhancements, and fixes based on business value, user impact, and risk.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and daily scrums with platform admins, developers, and implementation partners.
* Own requirements across Salesforce clouds and capabilities in use (such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, reporting and forecasting, and Agentforce/AI features), including release readiness and user acceptance testing.
* Own requirements for integrations with adjacent systems, including SSO (Microsoft Entra ID), Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, Microsoft 365 and Teams, marketing automation, and data platforms; coordinate design, testing, and release.
* Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to streamline lead-to-cash and opportunity-to-quote processes, reducing manual effort and improving data quality and forecast accuracy.
* Define and maintain data standards, object and field governance, and metadata ownership; oversee data quality, deduplication, and hygiene for accounts, contacts, and opportunities.
* Drive adoption and governance of AI-enabled capabilities, including usage controls, cost tracking, and responsible-use guardrails.
* Build and track platform KPIs (user adoption, data quality, process cycle time, release quality, user satisfaction) and deliver reporting and dashboards to stakeholders and leadership.
* Run intake and triage for enhancement requests and incidents, manage the Salesforce vendor and implementation partner relationships, and publish release notes.
* Manage the Salesforce seasonal release cycle, evaluating new functionality and sequencing change to minimize disruption and maximize adoption.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Compliance to keep the platform aligned with data protection requirements, access controls, and regional obligations.
* Create admin and end-user enablement, and support change management and communications for platform updates.

**C) What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
===========================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 4–6 years of experience in product ownership, business systems, or CRM, including at least 2 years owning, administering, or configuring Salesforce in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience managing a product backlog and writing user stories in an agile/Scrum environment.
* Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model, declarative configuration (Flow, validation rules, permission sets), and integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, SSO/SAML, and middleware.
* Strong analytical skills; able to build Salesforce reports and dashboards, interpret pipeline and adoption data, and turn metrics into decisions.
* Proven stakeholder management across business, IT, and vendor teams, with the ability to balance competing priorities and say no with data.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to senior leaders.

**D) What You’ll Bring**
========================

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or similar certification.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, or CPQ Specialist (strongly preferred).
* Experience with CRM implementations, migrations, or multi-org consolidation, and with quote-to-cash processes.
* Familiarity with AI and generative AI capabilities in CRM (such as Agentforce and Einstein), and interest in applying them responsibly.
* Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, and reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL.
* Understanding of data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR) as they apply to customer and prospect data.
* Exposure to Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, or Microsoft 365 integrations.
* A customer- and seller-first, systems-oriented mindset, and the initiative to keep making the platform better. By owning Salesforce, you will directly shape how Teradata’s teams sell, serve, and succeed.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

  

**Manager, Business Intelligence**

  

We are hiring a Manager, Business Intelligence to lead reporting and analytics, standardize how the business measures itself, and respect the manual work that keeps reporting accurate today.

  

**Role overview:**

  

This role exists to turn a patchwork of manual, spreadsheet-driven reporting into a trusted, consistent reporting and analytics function, without losing the business knowledge embedded in those manual processes.

The Manager, Business Intelligence will keep critical manual reports running accurately while the team builds toward standard definitions, reusable data assets and self-service. The ideal candidate has done manual reporting hands-on, understands why it exists, and knows which tasks to automate, which to standardize and which to keep manual for now.

The role splits roughly as follows:

* **Reporting and analytics delivery (about 40%):** recurring, ad hoc and executive reporting, plus insight generation

* **Standardization and governance (about 30%):** KPI definitions, templates, documentation, report rationalization

* **Team leadership and stakeholder management (about 30%):** people development, intake, prioritization, communication

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

**Reporting and analytics delivery**

* Own the recurring reporting calendar (weekly, monthly, quarter-end), including reports that are still built manually in Excel or similar tools.

* Ensure manual reports are accurate, reconciled and documented, and run them hands-on when the team needs support or when a process is not yet ready to automate.

* Deliver ad hoc analysis and executive reporting that explains what changed, why it changed and what to do next.

* Build and maintain dashboards and scorecards in the enterprise BI platform (for example Power BI or Tableau).

Translate business questions into clear requirements, data pulls and decision-ready insights.  

  

**Standardization and governance**

* Define and maintain standard KPIs and metric definitions across business units, with a single source of truth for each.

* Create reporting templates, a data dictionary and standard operating procedures for recurring reports.

* Review the current report inventory, retire duplicates and consolidate overlapping reports.

* Partner with data engineering and IT on data quality, data models and a governed semantic layer.

Set a clear path from manual to automated: prioritize what to automate by effort, risk and business value.  

  

**Team leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of analysts and report developers; set goals and run regular feedback.

* Set team standards for quality, peer review, version control and documentation.

* Manage workload, intake and prioritization so urgent requests do not displace planned improvements.

Manage offshore, vendor or contractor resources where applicable.  

  

**Stakeholder management and change:**

* Act as the main point of contact for business partners on reporting and analytics needs.

* Run governance forums or a reporting council to agree on definitions and priorities.

* Lead adoption of standard reports and self-service, working with teams who rely on their own spreadsheets rather than overriding them.

* Communicate changes, outages and data caveats clearly and early.

**Continuous improvement:**

* Track reporting turnaround time, error rates, manual effort hours and user adoption.

* Introduce automation and process improvements where they pay back, and document the results.

Keep up with BI tooling and practice, and recommend upgrades where they help the business.  

  

**Required qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 10 or more years of total experience in business intelligence, reporting or analytics, including at least 3 years leading people or teams, and a progression from hands-on analyst or developer work into senior ownership of reporting.

* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, Power Query, lookup functions; VBA or macros a plus), with real experience running manual reporting processes.

* Strong SQL skills for extracting, joining and validating data from multiple sources.

* Hands-on experience with an enterprise BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker or Qlik, including dashboard design.

* Proven track record of standardizing KPIs or reports across multiple teams or business units, with examples of reduced report counts, faster turnaround or higher data trust, and the experience to set reporting strategy and roadmap rather than only execute it.

* Experience with data quality, reconciliation and controls on reports used for management or financial decisions.

* Ability to write clear requirements and documentation, including SOPs and data definitions.

Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting insights to senior leaders.  

  

**Preferred qualifications:**

  

* Master's degree or an analytics, data or business certification (for example a Microsoft Power BI certification).

* Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure Synapse, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks.

* Experience with DAX, data modelling and a semantic layer.

* Experience with automation and ETL tools such as Alteryx, Power Automate, Azure Data Factory, SSIS or dbt.

* Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation.

* Process improvement training (Lean or Six Sigma) or a track record of formal process redesign.

Experience building a reporting center of excellence or a self-service analytics program.

jobs.description:
**Key responsibilities**

**Sales plan**

* Deliver GIO's annual sales plan: new-business ACV, pipeline coverage and mix by product line (DRM, GISA, Team).
* Build a sales approach for each target segment: UK accountancy practices, audit firms, the Strategic Partner Client's network, and direct-to-SME.
* Recommend pricing and deal structures to the Group CEO and negotiate terms within agreed guidelines, balancing win rate with margin and delivery capacity.
* Report sales performance to the Group CEO; run the weekly sales meeting against plan.

**Selling and senior relationships**

* Personally lead the largest and most strategic opportunities, from first meeting to signed contract, and pass introductions from your own network to the Business Development Executive to close.
* Sell to practice owners, audit partners, managing partners and SME finance leaders; handle objections on quality, data security, staff retention and AI use.
* Shape proposals and pilots that lower the buyer's risk (trial periods, transition offers, phased onboarding) without eroding long-term value.

**Channel and partnerships**

* Act as Relationship Partner for the Strategic Partner Client: grow adoption across its network, protect existing relationships and rebuild confidence where delivery has fallen short.
* Identify, negotiate and close new strategic partnerships and referral channels (software vendors, professional bodies, networks and events), supported by the Business Development Executive.

**Team and sales process**

* Lead, coach and set targets for the Key Account Manager, the telesales team and the Business Development Executive.
* Own the CRM, pipeline stages, activity standards and reporting, so the forecast is accurate and the team works from one source of truth.

**Client growth and retention**

* Lead the Key Account Manager on account plans, upsell and cross-sell (e.g. adding audit or tax to an accounts client).
* Feed client and market insight back to delivery so the service matches what GIO sells; escalate and resolve at-risk accounts early.

**Measures of success**

* New-business ACV against plan (baseline and stretch targets).
* Qualified pipeline coverage of at least 3x the remaining annual target.
* Win rate and average deal value by product line.
* Net client retention, including Strategic Partner Client retention.
* Team activity and conversion: calls, meetings booked, meetings to proposal, proposal to win.
* Forecast accuracy month on month.

**Experience**

* 8+ years in B2B services sales, with at least 3 years leading a sales team.
* A track record of selling outsourced or offshore services, ideally to accountancy, audit or professional services firms (would consider experience in other sectors that can demonstrate adaptability).
* Has built or rebuilt a sales function, including CRM, process, KPIs and hiring.
* Has built strong working relationships with offshore delivery teams entirely remotely, ideally in India and South Africa, without relying on site visits.
* Has led a remote or distributed team, including people based in other countries.
* Experience running a channel or strategic partner network is a strong advantage.
* An accountancy qualification is not required; an understanding of how UK Accountancy practices and audit firms operate is.

**Skills and attributes**

* Credible with partners and business owners; sells on outcomes, not features.
* Commercially rigorous: comfortable with pricing models, margin, capacity and contract terms.
* Data-led: runs the business from the pipeline and the numbers.
* Builds trust and influence remotely: earns the confidence of delivery leaders in India and South Africa over video calls, without in-person visits.
* Self-motivated and disciplined when working remotely; keeps a steady rhythm of contact across time zones.
* Hands-on: willing to make the calls and write the proposals while building the team.

jobs.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
Your day at NTT DATA
  
The Senior Manager, Service/Product Offer Management is a senior management role, responsible for developing, owning and driving product and service strategies.
  
  
By using their market focus and expertise, this role ensures that the organization’s product and service offerings remain relevant, sustainable, compelling and competitive within the markets they are designed to serve.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Service/Product Offer Management is required to own and drive the product management strategy in their assigned business unit/division and is also responsible for identifying opportunities for new product and services development or for the enhancements to existing products and services.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**  

* Develops, owns and drives product strategies and cascade the organization’s overall product strategies into the business divisions and to the relevant stakeholders.
* Analyzes current market trends, conducts market research and specifies market requirements for current and future products.
* Sources or develops concepts for new products to investigate and identify enhancement concepts for existing products.
* Determines the feasibility of the concept for development and define and develop the product specifications.
* Takes responsibility for the definition, monitoring and management of the lifecycle roadmap for each product in the portfolio.
* Vets the suitability of vendors and partners, alliances and suppliers.
* Develops and delivers product training and communication to client facing staff and relevant internal stakeholders.
* Establishes, develops and maintains product-pricing models and contribute to the identification of suitable promotional techniques and sales and distribution channels.
* Works with marketing colleagues to colleagues to perform client, competitor and market analysis.
* Gathers and prioritizes product and client requirements to identify opportunities and to define the product vision.
* Identifies the opportunities for new product development or for the enhancements to existing products.
* Responsible for continuing product evolution, product enhancements, the introduction of new product features and functions and the retirement of certain products or variations to ensure product relevance and competitiveness.
* Educates the relevant internal stakeholders on new or enhanced product offering to enable sales optimization and client satisfaction.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**  

* Extended knowledge of market segments and product portfolio categories
* Extended knowledge of product lifecycles and technology solutions.
* Extended knowledge of product management disciplines and tools.
* Demonstrate financial awareness and commercial acumen.
* Possesses strategic thinking skills with sound presentation and public speaking abilities.
* Extended problem analysis and solution formulation capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication ability.
* Extended people management skills and the ability to coach other.
* Extended understanding of the organization's transformation and change programs.
* Demonstrate a sound understanding of the technologies related to product areas
* Extended understanding of the product’s functionality and capability.
* Displays an astute mind-set with critical thinking ability.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computer Science or Business or related field.
* Relevant certifications such as Scaled Agile and ITIL are beneficial.

**Required experience:**  

* Extended experience in a similar position, preferably gained within a global technology services organization.
* Extended experience gained within the technology industry.

jobs.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's wireless and local area network product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.
  
  
The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Experience delivering local area network or wireless capabilities as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team.
* Capability in Team Backlog prioritisation, story definition, acceptance criteria, Planning Interval events and iteration execution.
* Evidence of delivering campus network improvements that increased coverage, user experience or reliability.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Product Owner qualification, such as SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager or Certified Scrum Product Owner.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Meraki, Juniper EX or Juniper Mist.
* Experience with network assurance, Internet of Things or operational technology connectivity.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.

jobs.description:
We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
  
  
You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end-to-end.
  
  
You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
  
  
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with platform PMs
  
  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success

**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
AI-native products or features that users love
  
  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.

Core capabilities
  
  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.

Nice to have
  
  

* Shipped copilot or AI-assisted features in a production SaaS product

As a Consultant Data Engineer at Principal Financial Group, you will lead enterprise-scale data engineering delivery for our Data & Analytics Technology Program. This role will define technical direction, guide architecture decisions, mentor engineers, improve engineering culture, and drive predictable, high-quality delivery. The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on expertise in Snowflake, AWS, Python, SQL, and modern orchestration, with the ability to translate business and product priorities into resilient, governed, and scalable data products.

**Qualifications**

Experience: **8 to 11 years (With Tech Lead experience)**

Bachelor’s(Engineering)/Master’s in computer science or a related field.

* Deep expertise in **Snowflake, AWS, Python, SQL, Airflow, GitHub, and relational data platforms**.
* Strong capability in data architecture, dimensional modeling, pipeline optimization, data quality, and governance engineering.
* Proven experience designing reusable frameworks, automation patterns, CI/CD practices, and production-ready data products.
* **Leadership in architecture reviews, technical strategy, discovery, dependency management, and delivery-risk mitigation.**
* Proven outcome driven usage of AI-powered engineering tools, including GitHub Copilot, Snowflake Cortex, and other approved GenAI solutions, to improve developer productivity, code quality, documentation, test case generation, and troubleshooting, while ensuring compliance with organizational security, privacy, and responsible AI guidelines.
* Strong communication, mentoring, stakeholder influence, and cross-team collaboration skills.

* Hands-on experience with Snowpark for building scalable data transformation frameworks.
* Change data capture, secure data sharing, masking, backfill, and reprocessing patterns.
* Snowflake error handling, pipeline resilience, and integration with AWS services such as S3, Glue, and Lambda.
* Advanced SQL tuning, query profiling, clustering, partitioning, and workload management for large analytical workloads.

Cloud & Platform Engineering — AWS

* Secure, scalable, cost-aware cloud data processing using batch, event-driven, and serverless patterns.

Programming & Automation — Python / SQL

* Advanced SQL for complex transformations, reconciliation, performance tuning, and analytical validation.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
jobs.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Lead the service transformation teams**

Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans.

**Turn architecture into shipped services**

Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered.

**Establish the base service tier**

Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application — and the AI agents and partners building on top of them — can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably.

**Protect compatibility and business continuity**

Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved.

**Modernize the application foundations**

Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.

**Raise the bar for engineering quality**

Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops — layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience — that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly.

**Drive AI-native ways of working**

Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.

Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates — not manual inspection — prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation.

**Hire and grow strong engineers**

Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through.

**Partner across the program**

Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed.

**What This Is Not**

This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.

This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.

This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Proven engineering leadership**

Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health.

**Service transformation depth**

Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.

**Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency**

Enough hands-on depth — in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems — to review designs, ask the hard ques…

jobs.description:
FBS – Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.

We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.

Since we don’t have a local legal entity, we’ve partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.

 **Requirements**

Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using basic coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with frequent support and guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements. Define and execute tests early, often, and at multiple levels. Based on business products, processes and system knowledge, provides basic level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems utilizing simple testing techniques and tools. The Agile Dev Team Member I will rarely work on more than one type of task and limited in to consistently pull the next highest priority work item.

* Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting basic process or system solutions and providing input into system design.
* Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria.
* Performs basic impact assessment relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points.
* Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality.
* Demonstrates understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality.

**Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a development discipline:**

* Demonstrates entry level developer skills with basic ability to code instructions for computer programs and limited ability to configure packaged software.
* Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions with guidance from senior team members. Performs basic quality checks of program code, related objects and documentation.
* Delivers working code each sprint. Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability.
* Identifies common errors that occur in standard application testing. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data.
* Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines basic test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage.
* Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes basic testing tools and executes basic data creation tools.
* Demonstrates ability to read automation test results. Demonstrates understanding and applies concepts of Risk Based Testing.
* Demonstrates limited ability to write test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation.
* Supports application development, implementation, and user training activities, as required.
* Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency with guidance from a senior team member.
* Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, including the development and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals.
* Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos.
* Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories.
* Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions.
* Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise.
* Actively seeks out development opportunities to develop T-shaped skills and become a cross-functional contributor.
* Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps.
* Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes.
* Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP). Can facilitate CoP sessions with guidance from leadership and/or peers

  
**Benefits**

Competitive compensation and benefits package:

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training & Development

jobs.title: BI Developer
jobs.description:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.  
  
Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.  
  
For more information, visit www.supplier.io.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Developer with 2–3 years of experience to design, build, and maintain analytics solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, using data sourced from Snowflake and other enterprise systems. You will turn business questions into well-modeled, high-performing reports and dashboards, with strong DAX at the core of your work, and you will work closely with analysts, data engineers, and business stakeholders.

**Position reports to:** Team Lead – Business Intelligence

**What You Will Do**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders and product owners to gather requirements and translate them into reliable, easy-to-use BI solutions.
* Design and develop optimized star-schema data models and semantic models in Power BI, with sensible relationships, hierarchies, and calculation logic.
* Write and optimize DAX measures, including time intelligence, ranking, semi-additive, and dynamic calculations, and build Power Query (M) transformations.

* Write efficient SQL against Snowflake and other relational sources to extract, shape, and validate data for reporting.
* Configure scheduled and incremental refresh, implement Row-Level Security (RLS), and troubleshoot refresh failures and data issues.
* Tune report, model, and DAX performance using Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, and Tabular Editor.
* Use Git and Deployment Pipelines to promote content across Dev, Test, and Prod environments.
* Validate and reconcile data against source systems before release, and provide production support for BI solutions.
* Maintain technical and functional documentation, including data models, measures, and business definitions.
* Stay current with emerging features and best practices in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and cloud data platforms.

**What You’ll Need to Succeed:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
* 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Business Intelligence, with a strong focus on Power BI
* Strong, extensive DAX: CALCULATE, filter and row context, context transition, iterators, variables, time intelligence, ALL / ALLSELECTED / KEEPFILTERS, TOPN / RANKX, and calculation groups
* Strong Power BI development skills: semantic modeling, Power Query (M) with an understanding of query folding, data visualization, and report and dashboard development
* Solid understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts (Star Schema, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT)
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Semantic Models, and OneLake
* Working knowledge of Snowflake (virtual warehouses, roles and access, querying and connecting from Power BI/Fabric)
* Strong SQL skills (joins, window functions, CTEs, aggregations) and experience with relational databases
* Experience implementing Row-Level Security (RLS) and managing refresh schedules in the Power BI service
* Familiarity with version control tools such as Git
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into data-driven solutions
* Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders

**Nice to Have:**

* Microsoft certifications such as PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) or DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer); SnowPro Core certification
* Experience with incremental refresh, composite models, aggregations, or Direct Lake semantic models
* Experience with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and ALM Toolkit
* Familiarity with PySpark or Spark SQL in Fabric notebooks
* Exposure to Fabric Real-Time Analytics (Event Streams, KQL databases) or Databricks
* Exposure to Copilot, AI-powered analytics, or predictive analytics solutions
* Experience using Figma or similar tools for dashboard wireframing, and an understanding of UX/UI principles in data visualization

IND Senior Software Engineer - GCC024

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

**Job Description: SDET – Playwright & Test Automation**

**Location:** Hyderabad, India
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
  
**Experience:** 4-6 years

**Position Overview**

  
  

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in **Playwright-based UI automation**, API testing, modern programming practices, and CI/CD integration. This individual will own quality outcomes—not merely test execution—and partner with product, engineering, architecture, and business teams to improve release confidence, speed-to-market, customer experience, and production stability.

Key Responsibilities:

**Automation Strategy and Architecture**

* Define and implement an enterprise-grade test automation strategy across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.

* Architect scalable and reusable automation frameworks using **Playwright with TypeScript or JavaScript**.

* Establish framework standards for modularity, maintainability, parallel execution, cross-browser testing, reporting, and failure diagnostics.

* Guide the appropriate use of unit, component, API, contract, integration, UI, and end-to-end.

* Reduce dependence on manual regression through risk-based, sustainable automation.

**Quality Engineering and Shift-Left Practices**

* Drive shift-left quality by influencing requirements, acceptance criteria, solution designs, and testability.

* Define the overall test approach, quality gates, automation coverage targets, and release-readiness criteria.

* Champion test-driven development, behavior-driven development, API-first testing, and early defect prevention.

* Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to create clear, testable acceptance criteria.

**Code Quality and Engineering Standards**

* Conduct automation design and code reviews and ensure adherence to programming, security, and maintainability standards.

* Establish reusable libraries, coding guidelines, test patterns, branching practices, and Definition of Done.

* Ensure automated tests are reliable, independent, maintainable, and resistant to flaky execution.

* Implement effective test reporting, failure analysis, defect triage, and root-cause analysis practices.

**CI/CD, Cloud and Non-Functional Quality**

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast and actionable feedback.

* Enable parallel, cross-browser, environment-based, and scheduled test execution.

* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve test environment availability, test data provisioning, and pipeline reliability.

* Contribute to performance, accessibility, security, compatibility, and resiliency testing strategies.

* Implement dashboards and quality metrics that provide visibility into coverage, defects, execution stability, and release risk.

**Stakeholder and Business Outcome Ownership**

* Communicate quality status, release risks, dependencies, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Provide objective, data-driven release-readiness assessments rather than limiting accountability to test completion.

* Drive measurable improvements in release confidence, escaped defects, automation coverage, cycle time, and customer experience.

MUST HAVE Skills:

* 12–15 years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles, including technical leadership responsibilities.

* Deep hands-on experience designing and developing automation frameworks using **Playwright**.

* Strong programming capability in **TypeScript or JavaScript**; working knowledge of Python or Java is valuable.

* Strong experience testing modern web applications across multiple browsers and responsive interfaces.

* Expertise in API testing using tools or frameworks such as **Karate, REST Assured, Playwright API, Postman, or equivalent**.

* Experience designing maintainable automation using page/component models, reusable fixtures, data-driven approaches, and appropriate design patterns.

* Strong knowledge of test pyramid principles, shift-left testing, risk-based testing, and quality engineering practices.

* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent.

**Company Description**

**ABOUT IQ-EQ**

Is a global investor services group with deep expertise in private markets. We support investment managers, asset owners and global businesses with the administration, compliance, governance, data and reporting that their structures depend on.

Across 25 jurisdictions, our 6,500+ professionals combine technical strength, connected technology and human understanding – the IQ and the EQ – to free clients from operational complexity and give them the peace of mind to focus on their core business activities.

Our IQ is our technical, regulatory and operational expertise, underpinned by data, technology and coordinated global delivery. Our EQ is our human partnership: understanding the business behind the numbers, the culture behind the structures and the individuals behind the screens.

With more than US$950 billion of assets under administration, our global client base includes 13 of the world’s top 15 private equity firms\* and 19 of the top 25 private debt firms\*\*.

One relationship connects our clients to the right expertise as needs evolve, helping them move forward with clarity and confidence, wherever they operate..

---------------

Amazon's Verification & Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk.  
  
BAR designs and builds the inspection systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant.  
  
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.  
  
We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real-time and close to real-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.  
  
Using LLMs will be critical requirement for this role as it needs experimentation and agent experience.
  
  
Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, QuickSight/Tableau/PowerBI and scripting languages (Python/JavaScript) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Organisation skills – demonstrated ability to work independently to make complex investigations, has self-discipline, is diligent and can manage time appropriately.
* Communication skills – ability to communicate (written and spoken) in English. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical problems in simple plain stories
* Automation of manual data processes, including data quality and validation
* Reporting using widely available reporting tools, for instance Quicksight or Tableau
* Ability to translate ambiguous work-streams in to tangible requirements, and success metrics, including ability to build metrics and metrics decks.
* Ability to earn trust among widely differing stakeholders of different roles, responsibilities, geographical location, and, culture.

Using LLMs and Agents for efficiency improvement

------------------------

* 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* 2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
* Knowledge of Python, VBA, Macros, Selenium scripts
* Knowledge of SQL

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Date:** 27 Nov 2026

**Location:** Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500081

**Company:** Orica

**About Orica**
---------------

At Orica, it’s the power of our people that leads change and shapes our futures. Every day, all around the world, our people help mobilise vital resources essential to progress. Established in 1874, we have grown to become the world leader in mining and civil blasting with a diverse of team of more than 13,000 across the world.

It’s an exciting time to join us – we are shaping the future of mining through digital and automated technologies, embracing new ways of thinking, pioneering innovation and reimagining the way we work.

**About the role**
------------------

Join Orica’s Hyderabad Technology Centre as a **Data Analyst** and help transform complex data into insights that support better decisions across our global business. You will work with internal specialists and stakeholders to develop scalable analytics, machine-learning, and AI solutions using operational, customer, and third-party data.

  

This is an opportunity to work with modern technologies, including Azure, Power BI, predictive modelling, Generative AI, and automation tools. Your work will contribute to real-world operational outcomes while helping expand Orica’s global data analytics capabilities.

**What you will be doing**
--------------------------

In this role, you will:

* Partner with specialists and internal stakeholders to understand analytics requirements, define critical metrics and KPIs, and deliver actionable insights.
* Design and implement scalable data-acquisition and integration solutions using the appropriate tools within the technology environment.
* Build and maintain databases, data pipelines, and scripts to support flexible and scalable analysis.
* Perform data cleansing and quality assessments to maintain data accuracy and integrity.
* Analyse operational and blast-measurement data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
* Develop, test, deploy, and monitor predictive models using machine-learning techniques.
* Create interactive dashboards and visualisations using information from multiple data sources.
* Develop AI-powered data solutions and decision-support tools for internal stakeholders.
* Complete user acceptance testing and resolve data-related issues or performance bottlenecks.
* Maintain clear technical and solution documentation.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to safety and follow Orica’s global operating procedures.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Tertiary qualification in **Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Science, or a related discipline**.
* Minimum **5 years’ experience in data analytics and AI**, preferably within an Azure environment.
* Strong experience in **data analytics, Power BI, machine learning, predictive modelling, and deploying ML solutions**.
* Proficiency in **SQL, Python, R or PySpark**, with experience in data modelling and relational/non-relational databases.
* Hands-on experience with **Generative AI and Azure technologies**, such as Azure AI Services, Copilot Studio, Azure ML, Synapse Analytics, Data Factory, and Power Platform.
* Strong **stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills**; exposure to mining or minerals-industry data would be an advantage.

**What we offer**
-----------------

As part of a truly global company, you will have the ability to grow and learn in a diverse, collaborative culture. We foster relationships and learning through connected global and local teams, promote flexible and diverse career paths and support the development of your knowledge and skills.

  

You will be paid a competitive salary, learn from talented individuals across multiple disciplines and be able to thrive in a safe workplace within a collaborative culture. Ignite your career at a place where your distinct potential can find its home.

**We respect and value all**
----------------------------

Orica promotes and fosters a culture of inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment everywhere we operate. We treat our people and applicants with fairness, dignity, and respect, getting the best of everyone’s contributions.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, nationality, age, military or veteran, marital or disability status.

jobs.description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Business Analyst, Strategy**

The Business Analyst, Strategy is a key planning, analysis, and execution role within Teradata’s Strategy organization. Reporting to the VP of Strategy and Strategic Planning, this individual will deliver market and competitive intelligence, business analysis, executive decision support, and program management for priority strategic initiatives. The analyst will combine rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis with effective use of approved AI tools to accelerate research, identify insights, test hypotheses, and improve the quality and speed of deliverables. The role also supports initiative tracking, cross-functional execution, and other high-priority needs across a global organization.

The ideal candidate has experience synthesizing qualitative and quantitative information, using analytics and visualization tools, and drafting executive-ready reports and presentations. Success requires sound judgment in the responsible use of AI, including validating outputs, protecting confidential information, documenting sources, and applying human review. The candidate must work effectively across functions, cultures, countries, and time zones with a high degree of confidentiality, independence, adaptability, attention to detail, and ownership in a fast-paced environment.

**The Team:**

We are a mission-driven, globally connected team focused on helping Teradata anticipate change, make stronger decisions, and drive measurable impact. We gather input from diverse internal and external sources, develop clear points of view, and partner across Product, Go-to-Market, Finance, Services, People, and other functions to translate strategy into action.

**The Day-to-Day Experience:**

You will bring curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a proactive, collaborative mindset. You will analyze complex issues, communicate clearly with global stakeholders, manage workstreams, and use modern digital and AI tools responsibly to increase productivity and insight. You will do this by:

* Frame strategic questions, identify root causes, and engage cross-functional leaders and subject-matter experts to develop fact-based perspectives.

* Conduct market, customer, competitor, and technology research; synthesize findings into actionable recommendations for senior leaders.

* Use approved generative AI, copilots, search, and automation tools to accelerate research, analysis, scenario development, drafting, and knowledge management while verifying accuracy, documenting sources, and safeguarding confidential data.

* Help build clear, concise, executive-ready presentations, written communications, and decision materials for senior management.

* Manage strategic workstreams, milestones, metrics, risks, dependencies, and action items; proactively surface issues and drive follow-through.

* Support ongoing strategic programs, including win-loss analysis, strategy refreshes, initiative acceleration, and enterprise performance tracking.

* Develop and maintain dashboards and analyses using tools such as Excel and Power BI, translating data into insights for stakeholders.

* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across regions and time zones, adapting communication and working practices for a global environment.

**Preferred Experience & Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in strategy, business analysis, market intelligence, consulting, corporate development, finance, operations, or a related field.

* Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to turn complex information into concise insights, recommendations, and executive-level communications.

* Practical proficiency with AI-enabled productivity and research tools, Microsoft 365, and data analysis or visualization tools; willingness to learn new tools rapidly.

* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including verification, privacy, security, intellectual property, bias awareness, and appropriate human oversight.

* Familiarity with enterprise technology, data, analytics, cloud, and AI market dynamics is preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate in a multicultural, distributed environment; professional fluency in English is required, and additional language skills are welcome.

* Candidates may be considered in countries where Teradata has an employing entity and can support the position. Employment is subject to local requirements, including eligibility to work in the applicable country; any immigration or sponsorship support will depend on role location and company policy.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

**Teradata’s Global Culture and ESG Commitment**

Teradata supports global teams through competitive, equitable, and inclusive programs and continues its environmental, social, and governance journey across data, people, stewardship, and integrity. Employment practices, benefits, workplace arrangements, and eligibility requirements vary by country and role. Learn more at https://bit.ly/3DZOD60.
