Solenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals, delivering sustainable solutions for water-intensive industries, including consumer, industrial, institutional, food and beverage, and pool and spa water markets. Owned by Platinum Equity, our innovative portfolio includes advanced water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, and state-of-the-art monitoring and control systems. These technologies enable our customers to optimize operations, enhance product quality, protect critical assets, and achieve their sustainability goals.

At our Global Excellence Center (GEC) in Hyderabad, we support Solenis’ global operations by driving excellence in IT, analytics, finance, and other critical business functions. Located in the heart of the IT hub, the GEC offers a dynamic work environment with strong career development opportunities in a rapidly growing yet stable organization. Employees benefit from world-class infrastructure, including an on-campus gym, recreation facilities, creche services, and convenient access to public transport.

Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, Solenis operates 70 manufacturing facilities worldwide and employs over 16,100 professionals across 130 countries. Recognized as a 2025 US Best Managed Company for the third consecutive year, Solenis is committed to fostering a culture of safety, diversity, and professional growth.

For more information about Solenis, please visit www.solenis.com.

**We're Hiring: Senior Business Analyst II**  
**Location: Hyderabad India – Hybrid**  
**Full-Time | Permanent Position**  
  
**What you need to be successful**

We're looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join our Analytics Hub supporting global FP&A & business. You'll turn complex data into insights that help us grow revenue, improve profitability and expand margins worldwide. You'll work with global finance & functional teams and report to the Analytics Hub Manager.

  

You'll own the quantitative analysis behind key business decisions, from building models to presenting dashboards to regional and global leaders.

This is a **business-facing analytics role, not an IT role**. We want someone who uses data to answer business questions and recommend actions.

**What You'll Do**

**Build analytical models (35%)**

* Understand the business objectives, research the problem, structure the model and deliver clear recommendations.
* Lead analysis on cost savings and COGS optimization, including COGS volatility, cost reduction and product mix changes.
* Forecast sales volume, PPV and pipeline.
* Find cost leakage and run elasticity and variance analysis.
* Model customer churn and spot ways to retain customers.

**Automate and optimize (25%)**

* Automate analytical models using SQL, Python, R, Power Automate, KNIME or similar tools.
* Keep improving existing analytics so they run faster and give more accurate results.

**Monitor and report on performance (40%)**

* Design and maintain automated dashboards for functional stakeholders, regional and global leaders, and the CXO team.
* Analyze and report regularly on business performance across pricing, product and procurement, and automate the reporting end to end.

What You'll Bring

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics or Engineering.
* A master's degree or certification in analytics is preferred.

**Experience**

* 4+ years of hands-on quantitative analytics experience, focused on business analysis rather than IT delivery.
* A track record of working in a fast-paced environment, managing competing requests and prioritizing well.

**Technical Skills**

* **Must have:** Strong skills in **Power BI, Tableau, SQL and Excel**
* **Good to have:** Python and/or R, Alteryx
* Deep knowledge of advanced analytics methods and the ability to turn data into recommendations.
* Working understanding of data science principles and machine learning.
* Comfortable collaborating virtually across voice, video, web conferencing and messaging tools.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Team-oriented, with an ownership mindset and a focus on outcomes.
* Driven by numbers and data, highly analytical and detail-oriented.
* Willing to roll up your sleeves and dig into problems.
* Strong communicator who raises and resolves issues proactively.

**Working Relationships**

* Reports to the Analytics Manager, Analytics Hub.
* Works closely with the offshore analytics team and the offshore Analytics Manager.

**Some benefits of working with us**

* Access to a huge array of internal and external training courses on our learning system (free)
* Access to self-paced language training (free)
* Birthday or wedding anniversary gift of INR 1500
* Charity work once a year, to give back to the community
* Company car, phone if required for role
* Competitive health and wellness benefit plan
* Continuous professional development with numerous opportunities for growth
* Creche facility
* Employee Business Resource Groups (EBRGs)
* Electric car charging stations
* Hybrid work arrangement eg. 3 days in office
* Internet allowance
* No-meeting Fridays
* Parking on site (free)
* Relocation assistance available
* Staff hangout spaces, enjoy games like carrom, chess
* Transport by cab if working the midnight – 7am shift
* Well connected to public transport, only a 10 min walk to office

We understand that candidates will not meet every single desired job requirement. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about *you.*

Solenis is constantly growing. Come and grow your career with us.

At Solenis, we understand that our greatest asset is our people. That is why we offer competitive compensation, and numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. So, if you are interested in working for a world-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, consider joining our team.

jobs.title: Sr. Business Analyst - Quality
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.  
We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.  
For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).  
‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency  
Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
Lead the administration, governance, compliance, continuous improvement, and digital transformation of LabWare LIMS and Caliber LIMS platforms. Responsible for application health, system performance, data quality, integrations, validation compliance, issue governance, business process optimization, and enabling data-driven Quality and Laboratory operations through reliable, scalable, and compliant digital solutions.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Serve as the Functional and Technical SME for LabWare LIMS and Caliber LIMS, responsible for system administration including user account management, role-based access control, workflow administration, master data management, configuration management, system maintenance, upgrades, and patch deployments.
* Ensure overall application health, performance, availability, reliability, security, compliance, and validated state of the LIMS applications through proactive monitoring, preventive maintenance, periodic reviews, and timely resolution of system issues.
* Monitor system usage, incidents, service requests, recurring issues, interface failures, and performance trends; perform Pareto, trend, thematic, and root cause analysis and drive governance reviews with business, Digital, and vendors to reduce recurring issues and improve system stability and user experience.
* Partner with Quality, QC, Manufacturing, Digital, and business stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable digital solutions.
* Lead business process mapping, fit-gap analysis, solution design, process harmonization, and automation initiatives to drive digital transformation across Quality and Laboratory operations.
* Manage and support integrations between LIMS, CDS, MES, ERP, laboratory instruments, and other manufacturing and enterprise systems, including interface troubleshooting, data flow validation, and coordination with relevant teams.
* Drive data governance activities including master data management, data quality monitoring, data standardization, and enabling reliable extraction, availability, and consumption of laboratory data for reporting, analytics, AI, digital solutions, and downstream business applications.
* Coordinate implementation, deployment, rollout, and stabilization, and change management activities activities while ensuring effective stakeholder communication, and risk management.
* Develop, review, and maintain system lifecycle documentation including URS, Functional Specifications, Design Specifications, SOPs, Risk Assessments, Validation Documents, Traceability Matrix, and related controlled documents.
* Lead and support Computerized System Validation (CSV) activities including impact assessments, IQ, OQ, PQ/UAT, SAT, change evaluations, qualification, and validation maintenance while ensuring compliance with GxP and Data Integrity requirements.
* Maintain and periodically update Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and related lifecycle documentation to ensure end-to-end traceability of requirements, enhancements, integrations, testing, validation deliverables, and system changes throughout the application lifecycle.
* Review, assess, test, and deploy application enhancements, configuration changes, vendor releases, software updates, and system upgrades while maintaining the validated state of the applications.
* Conduct periodic system reviews, user access reviews, audit trail reviews, backup verification, disaster recovery testing, and business continuity activities.
* Plan and deliver user training programs and promote adoption of system capabilities, best practices, and standardized business processes.
* Support internal audits, customer audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance assessments by providing system documentation, validation evidence, and application demonstrations.
* Collaborate with global and site teams to standardize laboratory processes and promote harmonized use of LabWare LIMS and Caliber LIMS across the organization.

jobs.title: Business Analyst I, Business assessment and reinforcement (BAR)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Verification & Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk.  
  
BAR designs and builds the inspection systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant.  
  
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.  
  
We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real-time and close to real-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.  
  
Using LLMs will be critical requirement for this role as it needs experimentation and agent experience.
  
  
Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, QuickSight/Tableau/PowerBI and scripting languages (Python/JavaScript) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Organisation skills – demonstrated ability to work independently to make complex investigations, has self-discipline, is diligent and can manage time appropriately.
* Communication skills – ability to communicate (written and spoken) in English. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical problems in simple plain stories
* Automation of manual data processes, including data quality and validation
* Reporting using widely available reporting tools, for instance Quicksight or Tableau
* Ability to translate ambiguous work-streams in to tangible requirements, and success metrics, including ability to build metrics and metrics decks.
* Ability to earn trust among widely differing stakeholders of different roles, responsibilities, geographical location, and, culture.

Using LLMs and Agents for efficiency improvement

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* 2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
* Knowledge of Python, VBA, Macros, Selenium scripts
* Knowledge of SQL

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Requirements Gathering and Solution Design:

● Gather Requirements from stakeholders across different Business areas.

● Design and document system solutions, including workflows and user stories.

● Basic knowledge of Integration with ERP FI-AA & MM-IM configuration and support.

● Create a Functional Design document or Business Requirements Document if needed.

● Asset lifecycle management (installation to retirement).

● SQL queries, data analysis, and API integration.

● Business analysis (AS-IS, FDD, BRD).

● Test case development and execution ( SIT, UAT).

● Collaborate with developers, various IT teams and Business teams to implement new systems.

● Test and troubleshoot system functionality for P0, P1, and P2 production issues. (P1 and P2 likely refer to high and medium priority bugs)

● Develop training materials and support users during system implementation. Additional Skills:

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. (Essential for BSA)

● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. (Needed to gather requirements, collaborate with stakeholders, and train users)

● Ability to work independently and as part of a team. (BSAs often work on independent tasks but also collaborate with various teams)

● SAP knowledge is a plus but not mandatory. (Knowledge of specific ERP systems can be valuable depending on the industry)

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - US healthcare domain (Nightshift)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Job Title:Business Analyst – US Healthcare

Shift Timings:7:30 PM - 4:30 AM IST

Location:PAN INDIA Remote, Work from Home

Experience Required:6 - 8 Years

**Role Overview**

This is an individual-contributor role working directly with US client business and IT teams. You own requirements validation, testing and UAT for assigned projects, from confirming requirements through to business sign-off, in an Agile delivery model.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review written requirements and confirm them with business stakeholders in live working sessions.
* Capture clarifications, edge cases and acceptance criteria, and keep requirements current as they change.
* Document business rules in plain English so technical and business teams share one understanding.
* Build and maintain a traceability matrix linking requirements, test cases and delivered code.
* Write test cases and scenarios for healthcare billing workflows such as claims, eligibility, adjudication and payment posting.
* Work with developers to confirm unit testing is completed and evidenced before code moves forward.
* Prepare test data and expected results across payer types.
* Plan and facilitate UAT with business users, track defects to closure, and secure sign-off.
* Produce weekly status reports covering progress, test coverage, defects, risks and next steps.
* Raise scope changes and risks early to project leadership.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Business Analysis**

* 5+ years as a Business Analyst on software delivery projects.
* Proven ability to run requirements sessions directly with US business stakeholders and get sign-off.
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum teams: backlog grooming, sprint reviews, short feedback loops.

**Testing & UAT**

* Hands-on experience writing traceable test cases and test scenarios.
* Experience planning and running UAT with business users.
* Defect management in Jira, Azure DevOps or a similar tool.

**Healthcare Domain**

* 3+ years in US healthcare revenue cycle, billing or related healthcare operations.
* General familiarity with US health insurance and payers.
* Awareness of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy.

**Data & Tools**

* SQL for test data setup and result validation.
* Excel for test tracking and reconciliation.
* Jira or Azure DevOps; Microsoft Teams.
* Excellent written and spoken English; clear, concise status reporting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on the provider, payer or medical supply side of US healthcare.
* Exposure to legacy system modernization projects.
* CBAP, CCBA, ISTQB, AAPC or HFMA (CRCR) certification.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration or a related field.

**Soft Skills & Cultural Fit**

* Self-starter who takes ownership without close supervision.
* Confident working directly with US client stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Clear communicator who simplifies complex billing rules for technical and business audiences.
* Adaptable to changing priorities and comfortable with US-overlap shift hours.

**Ideal Profile**

A hands-on healthcare BA who can take written requirements, turn them into solid test cases, and drive US business users through UAT to sign-off with little hand-holding.

**Skills and Knowledge**

Business Analysis, Requirements Validation, Test Case Design, UAT, US Healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management, Healthcare Billing, HIPAA, Agile/Scrum, Jira, Azure DevOps, SQL

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Wego**
--------------

**Wego is the leading travel app and the largest online travel marketplace in the Middle East and North Africa. Our mission is to make travel better by helping millions of people discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and travel experiences with confidence.**

**Founded in 2005, Wego has grown from a metasearch engine into a full travel platform, combining search with our own OTA products. We don't just point travelers at a fare: we sell it, ticket it, and stand behind it when plans change.**

**That means we own the whole transaction: the checkout, everything we sell alongside the ticket, and the tools our support agents use when a traveler needs help. This role works across all three.**

**Role summary**
----------------

**You will own product work across three areas of our flights booking business: new ancillary services, booking funnel optimisation, and improvements to the Customer Support Admin Tool our support agents use every day. You will join a team of product managers, including a Senior Product Manager who leads our post-booking work, and you will take features from problem definition to launch and measured result.**

**This is a product execution role. We care more about how well you take a problem from definition to a measured outcome than about how many years you have spent in travel. Flights experience helps, and you will learn the domain fast here, because the people around you know it deeply and the problems are concrete.**

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Feature ownership.** Own features and initiatives from problem statement to launch and measured result. Make the product calls within your scope, and know when to escalate.

**Specification.** Write clear PRDs, user stories, decision tables and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without a meeting. Cover the edge cases, the failure paths, and what we will not do.

**Delivery with engineering and design.** Work daily with engineering and design on scope, sequencing and trade-offs. Unblock decisions quickly. Keep scope honest when timelines slip.

**Experimentation.** Design and run A/B tests on the booking funnel and on ancillary offers. Define one primary metric and guardrails up front, test one change at a time where you can, and report results you would defend.

**Testing and launch.** Define test scenarios with QA and operations, run acceptance testing, plan staged rollouts with clear go/no-go criteria, and check that it works in production, not just in staging.

**Measurement.** Define the success metric for every feature before it is built. Instrument it, read the data yourself, and report what moved and why.

**Partnership with operations and commercial.** Work with customer support, finance and commercial teams, and with ancillary partners. Make sure every launch includes what support agents need to handle it.

**Communication.** Keep stakeholders informed with short written updates: what shipped, what it did, what's next, and what is blocked.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Required**

* **3+ years in product management, with direct ownership of features that shipped to customers or operational users.**
* **A strong execution record. You can point to features you took from a messy problem to a measured outcome, and explain the trade-offs you made along the way.**
* **Hands-on experimentation. You have designed and read A/B tests yourself, and you know the common ways they mislead.**
* **Excellent written specifications. Your PRDs and acceptance criteria are precise, cover edge cases, and hold up when engineers build from them.**
* **Analytical and hands-on with data. You write your own queries (SQL or equivalent), build the dashboard you need, and change your mind on evidence.**
* **Experience building for operational users, such as support agents, fulfillment or back-office teams, or a clear interest in doing so.**
* **Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the confidence to raise a problem early.**

### **Preferred**

* **Experience in travel, ideally flights: OTA, airline, GDS or travel-tech.**
* **E-commerce checkout, payments or conversion optimization.**
* **Ancillary or add-on products: insurance, protection, upsells, bundles.**
* **Internal tools for customer support or operations, such as agent consoles or case management.**

### **This is probably not the role for you if**

* **You prefer setting strategy to getting the details of a launch right.**
* **You'd rather hand testing, experiment analysis and post-launch checks to someone else.**
* **You see internal tools as less important than customer-facing products.**

Today, Wego is used by millions of people every month — people who travel for adventure, for work, for family and for many other reasons. That’s why we work tirelessly to make your experience of planning & booking flights, hotels and trips as seamless as possible.

**About the role and team**  
  
Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information—and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you won’t just manage a roadmap; you will build 0-to-1 platforms that bridge the digital and physical worlds. You’ll need to lead through influence, not control, and stay resilient while balancing the needs of external partners, engineering teams, and global business units. If you are a curious, owner-minded product leader who is energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact—this is where you’ll grow.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* Build a bold product vision and strategy for your domain, identifying near and long-term initiatives that unlock the next wave of Uber’s global growth.
* Design and ship scalable technology solutions—including APIs, orchestration layers, and developer tools—to deeply interpret and respond to complex marketplace signals.
* Navigate and align cross-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to drive cohesive product strategies despite competing priorities.
* Translate unstructured user pain points into clear product requirements by distilling complex problems, writing hypotheses, and defining measurable outcomes.
* Forge and manage strategic relationships with external partners, fintechs, or autonomous technology providers to scale deployments and optimize global operations.
Iterate relentlessly by distilling insights from performance dashboards, experimentation results, and user research to continuously raise the bar for quality and reliability.  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 6 + years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping large-scale projects each quarter that yield quantifiable impact.
* Proven ability to convert unstructured problems with significant ambiguity into clarifying, focused plans for multi-team projects.
* Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams.
* Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high-quality delivery.
* Demonstrated leadership in overseeing deeply experimental teams, partnering with data science managers to drive strong experimentation and data-driven prioritization.
* Proficient in UX/UI paradigms: Ability to own the design process for complex products, providing deep context to designers while driving fast iteration cycles for new concepts.
* Experience representing significant areas of work to executives to gather feedback, generate alignment, and garner support.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field.  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Domain expertise in Financial Services, Autonomous Vehicles, or high-scale Marketplace mechanics.
* Passionate about shipping "magical," defect-free products, overseeing quality monitoring, alerting, and retrospective processes.
* Proven recruiter and mentor: Ability to successfully hire for the team and serve as a coveted member of all product interview loops.
* Strategic 0-to-1 experience: Generating innovative ideas for new product areas and incorporating customer feedback into long-term visions.
Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will support the development and growth of ABB's weighing solutions portfolio by optimizing the offer portfolio and improving return on investment. You will be responsible for understanding market needs, customer requirements, and industry trends, translating these insights into product strategies, specifications, and development initiatives. You will play a key role throughout the product lifecycle, supporting portfolio planning, product launches, market positioning, pricing strategies, profitability, and continuous portfolio enhancement to deliver sustainable business growth and customer value.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role is contributing to the development of weighing portfolio for the Force measurement business line of ABB Measurement and Analytics division for Business area Automation in India region supporting globally.

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Managing the product portfolio of weighing solutions.
* Maintain product documentation including technical specification, product brochures, product manuals, application notes, success stories and other technical and sales material. Prepare and maintain price lists for review and approval
* Maintains and follows annual cycle of activities to govern product management for the assigned offering.
* Keeps the product group, Sales team, and channels informed on topics related to the offering, such as new offering availability, market, competition, quality, configuration, trends, and limitations.
* Ensures appropriate product training materials are available to train internal (Sales/Engineering/Service JFGs) and external customers, delivers training on new offering(s) to internal teams and customers.
* Understanding and following global or assigned area standards, market and customer requirements, and their impact on the current offer portfolio.
* Conducting valuation of market size and trends, as well as competitor analyses including identification of offering gaps and evaluating ABB’s market standing.
* Ensuring whether technical solutions can be used across the Product Group’s offer portfolio to the maximum possible extent.

**Qualifications for the role**

* You have 6-8 years of experience in product management, application engineering, or business development within the weighing, force measurement, process automation, or related industrial sectors.
* You possess knowledge of weighing solutions, applications, and systems, with exposure to industries such as Ferrous and Non-Ferrous metals, mining, cement, power, or other process industries.
* You have experience in managing product portfolios, supporting product lifecycle activities, developing technical documentation, and developing market-oriented product strategies.
* You demonstrate a solid understanding of market trends, customer requirements, competitor offerings, and value proposition development for industrial products and solutions.
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* You are motivated by developing innovative customer-centric solutions and collaborating with global stakeholders to support business growth and product performance.
* You are comfortable working in a global matrix organization and engaging with cross-functional teams across product management, sales, engineering, and service.
* You communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken.

**More About Us:**

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the largest manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analyzers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. The Measurement & Analytics Division’s portfolio consists of analyzers measuring compositions of gases and liquids; instrumentation measuring process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level; force measurement solutions measuring parameters such as flatness, thickness, and tension; and advanced digital solutions for device management, device health check and predictive maintenance. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. The Division enables the optimization of industrial processes by providing and analyzing data collected from sensing and smart measurement devices. Parameters such as emission levels and production inputs are measured by providing ‘before’ and ‘after’ values, enabling efficient operations and environmental sustainability through measurement.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

jobs.title: Kirana Club : Product Manager II - Commerce
jobs.description:
### **About the role**

You will own critical retailer-commerce journeys on Kirana Club, from product discovery and decision-making to checkout and repeat purchase. Your first and most important mandate will be to improve retailer activation—moving retailers from their first to fourth delivered order. This is an ambiguous, cross-functional problem spanning product experience, assortment, pricing, trust, fulfilment and user behaviour. You will be expected to identify where the real constraint lies, determine what product should solve, and build solutions that materially improve the business outcome.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the product roadmap for retailer activation, with an immediate focus on first-order conversion and progression from the first to fourth delivered order.
* Diagnose funnel and behavioural problems through data, user research and market visits rather than starting with predetermined features.
* Build and test solutions across discovery, product comprehension, cart, checkout, assisted buying, post-order and repeat journeys.
* Work closely with Growth, Design, Engineering, Data, Supply and Fulfilment, while distinguishing product problems from pricing, assortment and operational problems.
* Define success metrics, make clear product trade-offs and measure impact on delivered orders and repeat behaviour—not only clicks or feature adoption.
* Build scalable product systems rather than relying primarily on notifications, discounts or manual interventions.

### **What we're looking for**

* 6–9 years of total experience, including at least 4–6 years in product management, preferably in consumer commerce, marketplaces, fintech, quick commerce or another transactional product.
* Has independently owned a meaningful conversion, activation, retention, monetisation or transactional-funnel metric.
* Strong first-principles problem solver who can structure an ambiguous problem before jumping to solutions.
* Comfortable combining behavioural data, qualitative research and commercial understanding.
* Has built or materially improved a zero-to-one consumer journey, not only optimised an established feature backlog.
* Strong execution in a resource-constrained environment and comfortable working directly with business and operating teams.
* AI-native in research, analysis, prototyping and day-to-day product execution.
jobs.company_description:
Founded by two IIT-Delhi graduates, Vidit Aatrey and Sanjeev Barnwal in 2015, Meesho is India’s only true e-commerce marketplace. Meesho, which stands for "meri shop" or "my shop", connects millions of consumers with small sellers across India.
India’s unorganized retail represents a c.$800bn+ Target Addressable Market (TAM), which is 80-85% of the overall retail sector. In India, e-Commerce is expected to grow to c.$170-180bn by 2027 (c.35% CAGR ‘22-’27) led by nearly 500mm online shoppers in India, versus the current c.200mm base. This growth is expected to be led by consumers who are transitioning directly from unorganized trade to e-Commerce, especially those in the rising middle class of India. Meesho’s differentiated business model focuses on the underserved small sellers and value-first consumers. Leveraging tech innovations, seller-friendly policies and an asset-light structure, the platform has emerged as the lowest-cost destination catering to India’s price-conscious customers.
With a vision to be the e-Commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable 100 million small businesses to succeed online, Meesho is democratizing internet commerce in India. The company provides sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and the lowest shipping cost. Over 1.4 million sellers are registered on Meesho, growing their business by tapping the company’s massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, pan-India logistics at the lowest cost through third-party logistics providers in an ‘Everyday Lowest Cost’ channel for sellers.
With ~80% of Meesho’s 140 million annual transacting customers coming from tier 2+ cities and towns, the company has been instrumental in bringing new-to-e-commerce users online. Meesho has made e-Commerce more accessible, affordable and engaging for a unique and underserved ‘non-affluent’ user segment. With a strong value proposition of Everyday Lowest Prices, the platform hosts one of the largest selection of unique products (>65% product listings are unique to Meesho).
Meesho has so far raised ~$1.1 billion and was valued at c.$5 billion in its last round of funding, making it one of India’s most well capitalized growth names in the consumer internet space. It was also the first Indian startup to secure funding from Meta (Facebook). Other marquee investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund, Prosus Ventures, Elevation Capital, Sequoia Capital, Fidelity and BCapital Group have backed the company across multiple rounds. 

Be an agent of change. Join us today. We are hiring!

**Also, Be sure that your job offer is genuine!**

It has come to our notice that some people are using the name and logo of Meesho with a view to tarnish the image and reputation of Meesho. They are fraudulently offering jobs online on certain websites, through telephone calls or social media (Telegram, Whatsapp, Instagram etc.) and are asking people to deposit money or share personal bank information.

To prevent any more people falling victim to these frauds, we are sharing some information to help you spot genuine offers

How to identify genuine job offers?

1. During Meesho’s multi-round and merit-based employment recruitment practice, we NEVER charge, request or accept any fee or money from job seekers during or after the process.
2. Meesho will not ask for any confidential or financial information such as bank account number, tax details, recruitment fee, security deposit and similar during the selection process. After the offer letter is rolled out, the bank account details will be asked for however only send them to a ‘@meesho.com’ email address. Never share OTPs with anyone.
3. Meesho only collaborates with well-established recruitment agencies who are authorized by the company to source candidate profiles. However, they are not authorized to charge money/ fee to the applicants or to make a final job offer. 
4. Job seekers will always get a final offer from a ‘@meesho.com’ email address. 
5. If you are uncertain about the authenticity and description of the job opportunity, please visit our careers portal Meesho Careers as all our jobs are published there.
6. In case of any doubt about the interviewer, the interview process or the job description, feel free to reach out to reporthiringfraud@meesho.com to verify the authenticity of the information. 
7. If you believe you have been a victim of recruitment fraud, please contact law enforcement agencies immediately.

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Movado

Reporting directly to the General Manager – India, the incumbent will be responsible for managing existing business partnerships, identifying new business opportunities, developing retail formats and executing brand strategies to accelerate Movado's growth and market presence in India.
  
  
The role requires a commercially driven business leader with strong experience in premium retail, luxury brand management, channel development and partner management, with the ability to translate brand strategy into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

Brand Strategy & Business Management
  

* Develop and execute the overall brand strategy for Movado in India, aligned with global brand positioning and local business objectives.
* Drive brand awareness, market positioning and brand equity within the premium and luxury watch segment.
* Develop annual business and brand plans in consultation with the General Manager – India.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen market presence, expand distribution and improve brand penetration.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities and consumer preferences to identify business opportunities.
* Ensure consistency in brand identity, positioning and customer experience across all channels.

  
Business Development & Channel Expansion
  
- Lead channel development initiatives to expand Movado's presence across India.
  

* Identify, evaluate and onboard new business partners, distributors, franchisees and retail partners.
* Develop and strengthen existing partner relationships to drive business growth.
* Explore new retail formats and distribution opportunities aligned with the brand's premium positioning.
* Negotiate commercial terms and develop strategic partnerships to support business expansion.
* Identify potential markets, locations and retail opportunities for expansion.

* Work closely with retail partners to improve store performance, productivity and customer experience.
* Develop strategies to enhance store visibility, footfall, conversion and sales performance.
* Ensure retail execution is aligned with Movado's global brand and merchandising standards.
* Collaborate with Sales and Visual Merchandising teams to ensure effective implementation of brand initiatives.
* Monitor retail performance, identify gaps and implement corrective action plans.
* Support the development of new stores, shop-in-shops and other retail distribution formats.

Product & Category Management

Sales Manager

* Maintains and follows annual cycle of activities to govern product management for the assigned offering.

jobs.title: Kirana Club : Manager - Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

You'll own the performance marketing budget across Meta, Google, and other paid acquisition channels. This is a hands-on, spend-owning role — you build campaigns, test creatives, manage targeting and bids, and you're accountable for the math behind every rupee, not just the media plan you hand off to an agency. Our audience is largely non-metro, vernacular-first kirana store owners across Bharat, so a standard D2C playbook often won't work as-is — you'll need to build and test your own.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own and manage the monthly performance marketing budget across Meta, Google, and other paid channels
* Build, launch, and optimize campaigns end to end — creative testing, targeting, bid strategy, budget allocation across channels
* Own CAC, LTV, and ROAS for your spend — report on what's working, kill what isn't, fast
* Work with the creative team to test and iterate ad creative for a vernacular, non-metro audience
* Build attribution and tracking accurate enough to make real budget calls, not vanity dashboards
* Partner with growth and product so paid users land into onboarding flows that actually convert and retain

### **What We're Looking For**

* 6+ years in performance marketing, has managed a monthly budget upwards of ₹50L
* Experience marketing to non-metro, vernacular, or price-sensitive Indian audiences
* Deep hands-on expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads — not just briefing an agency
* Strong professional pedigree — a brand-name startup, agency, or company that signals you can be trusted with real budget
* Strong with numbers — builds your own CAC/ROAS models, doesn't wait on a data team to tell you if a

campaign worked  

* AI-native — uses AI for creative variants, copy testing, and analysis as a default
* Stayed long enough at your last few roles to see campaigns compound — no string of sub-year stints
* Based in Bangalore, ready to work from office
* Background in a marketplace, fintech, or consumer app built for Bharat

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
What you'll be responsible for
  
  
You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
* Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
* Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
* Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
* Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
* Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
* Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

What you'll bring to Circle
  
  
Core requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
* Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.
* Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.
* Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.
* Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

Why this role matters
  
  
Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.

JD: Product Manager – Agentic AI

**Joining within 45 days | Experience: 5 to 8 years | Location: Bangalore or Mumbai | On-site | Hands-on role**

Cogniflix Artificial Intelligence Pvt Ltd (Mindflix AI) is building the next generation of AI-powered personalisation and engagement systems across voice, conversational interfaces and real-time intelligence. We are persona-driven: we build live AI personas, avatars that talk, listen and respond like people. We are building for EdTech first, with healthcare to explore next.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our agentic AI products, starting with EdTech and then exploring healthcare.

Mindflix AI works from Bangalore and Mumbai and is being built with a global outlook, including a Singapore company structure to support international expansion, enterprise partnerships and future growth.

Role

**This is a hands-on role. You will lead the product and execute it yourself.**

You will set the direction and also do the detailed work: writing the requirements, testing the product, working through the data and driving delivery with engineering. There is no team under you to hand work to at the start, and there is the opportunity to build one as we grow.

You will work with the founders, the engineering team and our interns.

Key Responsibilities

* **Product strategy and roadmap:**
  define and prioritise what we build, aligned with business goals and customer needs.
* **Discovery:**
  understand customers and users first-hand, and turn their problems into clear, buildable requirements.
* **AI product quality:**
  work with AI engineers to define how our agents should behave, how quality is evaluated, and what is safe to ship.
* **Analytics and experimentation:**
  define success metrics, track adoption and conversion, and use data to decide what to do next.
* **Cross-functional execution:**
  drive delivery with engineering and design, and support launches and client rollouts.
* **New verticals:**
  build for EdTech first, then explore healthcare with us.
* **Ownership:**
  take the product from idea through launch, adoption and continuous improvement.

Must Have

* 5 to 8 years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in product management.
* End-to-end ownership of a live B2B or SaaS product, from discovery through launch and improvement.
* Practical experience building products with generative AI or agentic AI.
* Comfortable leading and executing at the same time: setting direction and doing the detailed work yourself.
* Technical fluency: APIs, data, and how LLM-based products are built and evaluated.
* Strong analytical skills, and the habit of deciding with data.
* Clear written and spoken communication, including requirements engineers can build from.
* Comfortable working directly with clients.
* Able to join within 45 days.

Good to Have

* Experience in EdTech or healthcare.
* Experience with conversational AI, voice AI, CRM or customer engagement products.
* Experience with multilingual products.
* Experience taking a product from zero to one in a startup.
* Hands-on comfort with SQL and analytics tools.

What We Look For

* Ownership from idea to outcome, not only to launch.
* Sound product judgement and structured problem-solving.
* Curiosity about how AI behaves in the real world, and the patience to read the conversations and the data.
* Pragmatism: the simplest thing that solves the customer's problem.
* Clear communication, documentation and timely escalation of blockers.
* Enthusiasm, and the belief that you can make a real impact in the real world. Open to grind and create.

What We Offer

* Ownership of a product line, not a slice of one.
* Direct work with the founders, the engineering team and our interns.
* Interesting work with live AI personas and avatars.
* The chance to shape the product from an early stage, and where the company goes next.
* The opportunity to build the product team as we grow.
* A high-ownership environment where product quality and execution are taken seriously.

How to Apply

Apply through this page -
https://forms.gle/9HR14qi1b8ciyJfB7

Compensation

Open for discussion

Location

On-site, at either of our offices:

jobs.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope
  
  
Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.
  
  
At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.
  
  
Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
  
  
**About The Role**
*Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.*
Netskope Product Managers use their passion for AI security to bridge customer business requirements with key market trends, and deliver world-class products to market. You will work closely with customers and prospects to present our solutions and understand their requirements, and you will partner with engineering, marketing and the field to define the product roadmap, launch the product and develop an effective GTM plan.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
We are looking for a talented Principal Product Manager who is passionate about creating a seamless experience for the enterprises as they adopt Netskope Skylight AI Security Platform. In this role you will lead the strategy and development of AI Agent security for AI applications and agents running locally, detect risky or anomalous behavior (such as prompt injection, data leakage, and unsanctioned tool use), and enable security teams to respond in real time.
  
  
You’ll partner with engineering, research, and customer-facing teams to secure risky agent actions on end user devices and agent platforms with well-defined security requirements, and shape the roadmap as AI agents become a core part of how employees work. Ideal candidates bring 10+ years of product management experience (including endpoint security), a deep understanding of how AI models, agents, and tool-calling protocols such as MCP work, and a track record of influencing without authority and explaining technical risk to both practitioners and executives.
  
  
As the product owner, you will define strategy, drive execution and collaborate with engineering, research and go to market teams to bring AI agent security to enterprise environments and security workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* You will be responsible for driving the vision, strategy, execution and roadmap.
* Translating customer business needs into product strategy and technology requirements as part of MRD and PRD
* Developing, managing and communicating the product roadmap to both internal and external key stakeholders
* Taking ownership of working with the broader team to ensure high-quality deliverables
* Ensuring optimal user experiences for end users by working closely with UX/UI designer and development teams on workflows, look-and-feel
* Developing compelling sales tools and marketing content to support sales and field marketing teams.
* Creating financial, market, and other analytical models to guide product pricing and go-to-market decisions
* Maintaining competitive matrix and competitive intelligence materials including hands-on product testing
* Traveling up to 25% (2x year to USA, customer meetings, trade shows)

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in product management.
* 5+ years of specialized experience in endpoint security or related cybersecurity markets.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering SaaS or cloud-native security products.
* Hands-on experience working with AI/ML solutions, including collaborating with technical AI/ML engineering teams.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead and contribute to cross-functional teams.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills (both written and verbal) for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Highly analytical with strong problem-solving skills, capable of navigating fast-paced environments and managing overlapping deliverables.
* A self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias for action and execution.

**Education**

* BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or MBA strongly preferred

ZEISS is an internationally leading technology enterprise operating in the fields of optics and optoelectronics. In the previous fiscal year, the ZEISS Group generated annual revenue totaling over 10 billion euros in its four segments Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology and Consumer Markets (status: 30 September 2024).

There is global demand for trendsetting ZEISS brand products such as eyeglass lenses, camera lenses and binoculars.

ZEISS invests 12 percent of its revenue in research and development – this high level of expenditure has a long tradition at ZEISS and is also an investment in the future.

With over 46,000 employees, ZEISS is active globally in almost 50 countries with around 30 production sites, 60 sales and service companies and 27 research and development facilities. Founded in 1846 in Jena, the company is headquartered in Oberkochen, Germany. The Carl Zeiss Foundation, one of the largest foundations in Germany committed to the promotion of science, is the sole owner of the holding company, Carl Zeiss AG (status: September 2024).

jobs.title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Quick highlights**

Location: Bengaluru, India. Full-time, on-site.

Experience: Freshers and candidates with 1–2 years of experience are welcome.

Reports to: Head of Operations and Delivery.

### **About Richpanel**

Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk for ecommerce. Our AI handles routine customer requests. People handle exceptions in the same helpdesk. We are profitable and backed by Sequoia.

### **The job**

You support the merchant teams who use Richpanel. When something breaks, you investigate it, explain what happened and stay responsible until the customer has a verified resolution.

Start with product training, practice cases and reviewed customer replies. Take on cases and shifts as you demonstrate readiness. Senior teammates and Engineering support complex escalations. Use what you learn to improve our documentation, testing and product. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, onboarding and Customer Success.

### **What you will own**

* Handle product questions and incidents through chat, email and customer calls. Understand the customer’s problem before suggesting a fix.

* Reproduce failures. Read the relevant conversation, policies, AI instructions, settings and available logs. Check API responses when needed.

* Separate missing or incorrect context from configuration, permissions and software failures. Explain what the evidence supports and what remains unknown.

* Fix issues within your authority. Escalate product defects with reproduction steps, affected records, expected behaviour, actual behaviour and customer impact.

* Keep customers informed. Give clear next steps and updates while another team investigates. Follow through across internal teams.

* Test the fix against the original failure before closing an issue. Verify that an action happened before telling the customer it succeeded.

* Hand over open issues between shifts with a named owner, current status and next action.

* Turn recurring issues into useful help articles, troubleshooting guides and test cases. Share repeat failure patterns with Product and Engineering.

### **Coverage and success**

Our support team provides 24x7 coverage. This role includes scheduled shifts, which may include nights and weekends. You must be comfortable working on-site in Bengaluru.

We measure response and resolution time, answer quality, reopens and customer experience together. Good work leaves the customer informed and the problem resolved.

### **How we assess**

Expect a short practical support case. You will investigate a failure, write a customer update and prepare an Engineering handoff. Then you will explain your reasoning in a live discussion.

 **Requirements**

* Freshers and candidates with 1–2 years of experience are welcome. Previous customer support employment is not required.
* You enjoy solving software problems. Show us an issue you investigated in a project, internship, job or personal work.
* You learn unfamiliar products quickly, ask precise questions and test your assumptions.
* Your spoken and written English is clear. You explain problems simply and stay calm with customers.
* You are willing to learn HTTP requests, JSON, logs and APIs. Previous experience with these is useful, but not required.
* You take initiative, work hard and follow up without prompting. You act on feedback and involve a teammate when needed.
* You check AI answers against product behaviour and verify that a fix worked before closing a case.

 **Benefits**  

### **Compensation**

₹8–14 lakh total target annual cash. The split is 70% fixed and 30% target variable, included within this range. Variable pay is based on quality, verified recovery and customer outcomes. Targets are agreed before the performance period.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
#### **Job Description**

**Location:** Bengaluru, with regular travel to our Raipur head office. **Reports to:** CEO. **Type:** Full-time.

### **About Elxer**

Elxer has connected Chhattisgarh since 2014. We run fibre broadband for homes and businesses, enterprise connectivity (leased lines, managed Wi-Fi and security), a data centre, and Elxer Solar for rooftop solar installations. We build much of our own technology in-house, including our customer app, field and sales app, HR system and a new operations platform, and we use AI across the business. We are now creating a product function, and we are looking for the leader to own it.

### **The role**

You will own what Elxer builds and sells, and why: the software our teams and customers use every day, and the services we add on top of a connection, a rack or a solar installation. You will turn business problems into clear, prioritised products, take them to real users and prove they work with measured results. You will not be judged on documents or features shipped alone.

You will work directly with the CEO. You will partner with the Software team, which owns architecture and delivery, and with Sales, Operations, Network, Support, Marketing, Finance and HR as business owners. An AI product assistant will support analysis, requirements drafting and reporting.

### **Key responsibilities**

**Portfolio and roadmap**

* Own one product portfolio across the new operations platform, the in-house systems that run the business today (customer and field apps, HRMS, billing and ticketing integrations) and our experimental tools.
* Build and run the idea register, scoring and quarterly roadmap. Decide with the CEO what to build, improve, retire or stop.
* Set clear rules for when an experimental tool becomes a supported product or is retired.

**Discovery and requirements**

* Spend regular time with field engineers, NOC, support agents, sales teams and customers to find the problems worth solving.
* Write problem statements, user journeys, acceptance criteria and non-goals that the Software team can estimate and build against.
* Make sure each business owner confirms the need before work starts and accepts the result before it counts as done.

**Commercial products and services**

* Shape the add-on and complementary products for home, enterprise, wholesale and solar customers, such as managed Wi-Fi, managed security, CCTV with cloud storage and solar maintenance.
* For each one, define the offer, SLA, pricing inputs, billing, fulfilment, support model and compliance checks, then hand over a launch-ready package to Sales and Marketing.
* Work with Finance on margin and with legal advisers on licence scope before anything is sold.

**Delivery and quality**

* Track each product slice from idea to production, and raise blockers early.
* Keep product data honest: correct metric definitions, complete records and dashboards management can trust.
* Plan releases with the Software lead, so changes reach users safely and with training.

**Measurement**

* Define and report product measures: active users by function, adoption, idea-to-production lead time, add-on attach rates and ARPU, churn and support tickets per customer.
* Present a monthly product review to the CEO.

**Team**

* Build the product function over time, starting with yourself and the AI assistant, and later product analysts or owners.

**Compliance**

* Make sure products follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, TRAI and DoT licence conditions, CERT-In directions and labour-law requirements where they apply.

### **What success looks like in the first year**

* One product register and roadmap in use across all software and services, reviewed every quarter.
* At least one platform slice used daily by real business users, with acceptance recorded by its business owner.
* Trusted definitions and dashboards for tickets, attendance and leads.
* At least two complementary products launched with measured attach rate and margin.
* A shorter, measured idea-to-production lead time.

### **Must have**

* 8+ years in product management, with 3+ years owning a roadmap and outcomes for an internal platform, a B2B product or a service business: ISP or telecom, SaaS, logistics, fintech, energy or a similar operations-heavy category.
* Has shipped products used by field or operations teams, not only web or consumer apps.
* Strong in discovery and requirements: can turn a messy workflow into clear acceptance criteria.
* Analytical: comfortable with SQL or BI tools, funnels, unit economics and product metrics.
* Works well with engineers. Understands APIs, data models, mobile apps and release processes well enough to make sound trade-offs.
* Excellent Hindi and English; clear writing.

### **Good to have**

* Experience with broadband or telecom systems: billing, Radius/AAA, ticketing, GIS or network inventory.
* Experience pricing and launching a service product, including SLAs and margins.
* Familiarity with HR, field-workforce or CRM systems.
* Uses AI tools in everyday product work.
* Engineering degree; MBA a plus, not a requirement.

### **What we offer**

* A leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with the mandate to build the product function from scratch.
* Real influence over what a growing regional technology group builds and sells.
* In-house engineering, our own data and AI tools to work with.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.

### **How to apply**

Apply on this page, or email your CV and a short note on a product you led, the problem it solved and the measured result, to **hr@elxer.com** with the subject "Head of Product".

jobs.title: Lead/Principal Product Management - AI PDLC Coach
jobs.description:
OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
At OpenText, the AI-native Product Development Lifecycle is changing how customer needs are understood, products are defined and product intent becomes working software. BMAD is a core framework in this transformation, using specialized agents, structured context and defined artifacts to connect discovery, product definition, UX, architecture, stories and implementation. As an AI-PDLC Product Coach, you will help Product Managers, Product Owners and UX partners use BMAD Definer workflows to create clear, evidence-grounded product context that Builder agents and Development teams can execute.This is a full-time, hands-on practitioner and transformation role, not a traditional training position or a general AI adoption role. You will work alongside teams to apply BMAD from idea clarification and discovery through PRDs, UX specifications, architecture handoffs, epics, stories and validation, helping teams adopt an agent-first approach while preserving product judgment, customer evidence and human accountability.
  
WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS
  
  

* Lead hands-on BMAD learning and embedded coaching for Product Managers, Product Owners and UX partners using real OpenText products, customer evidence and product workflows.
* Guide teams through BMAD Definer workflows spanning idea clarification, research, opportunity discovery, PRDs, UX specifications, prototypes, architecture collaboration, epics, stories, acceptance criteria and validation.
* Configure and refine BMAD agents, skills, workflows and context repositories so customer evidence, product strategy, UX, architecture and delivery constraints remain connected from discovery through build.
* Coach teams to produce BMAD artifacts with sufficient evidence, specificity, traceability and acceptance criteria for Builder agents and Development teams, while preventing unsupported or low-quality AI-generated product decisions.
* Partner with Product leaders and teams to diagnose adoption barriers, prioritize high-value use cases and measure improvements in cycle time, quality and business outcomes.
* Provide embedded coaching, office hours and targeted support that move teams beyond AI-assisted documentation toward BMAD-enabled, end-to-end product definition and delivery.
* Build and maintain reusable BMAD agents, skills, workflows, templates, context patterns and practical guidance that can scale across Product Management.
* Develop AI champions, facilitate showcases and peer learning, and contribute insights to the central AI-PDLC program.
* Work directly with Development Builders and Architects to ensure BMAD outputs provide the context, decisions and acceptance criteria required for reliable implementation and testing.
* Retain practical product delivery responsibility by helping teams create and validate real product definitions, prototypes and outcomes, rather than limiting the role to facilitation or document generation.
