jobs.title: ServiceNow Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Product Manager, ServiceNow
  
  
Ecolab is seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager to lead the ServiceNow product roadmap for GBS+ and the enterprise functions it supports.
  
  
GBS+ uses ServiceNow to manage cases, requests, approvals, tasks, service commitments, and operational workflows across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Legal, and other shared-services functions. As the product continues to expand, we need a leader who can bring these areas together around a consistent case-management model without forcing every function into the same process.
  
  
You will serve as the technical product owner for GBS+ capabilities built primarily on ServiceNow Customer Service Management. You will work with business product managers, process owners, Architecture, Engineering, UX, Data, Enterprise AI, QA, Delivery, and Operations to shape the roadmap and turn business needs into practical platform capabilities.
  
  
This role requires strong CSM knowledge and sound product judgment. You should be able to recognize when a request fits within native ServiceNow capabilities, when an existing pattern should be reused, and when a proposed solution creates unnecessary customization or long-term support risk.
  
  
This is not a project-management or requirements-documentation role. You will own product direction, roadmap priorities, functional decisions, adoption, and product health. You will stay engaged from discovery through delivery, launch, support, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Manager of ServiceNow Technical Product Management, this role will help expand GBS+ while keeping it aligned with the broader ServiceNow platform strategy.
  
  
What’s in It for You
  
  

* Shape the ServiceNow roadmap for GBS+ and enterprise shared services.
* Work across Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other business functions.
* Lead the expansion of case management, request management, workflow automation, and self-service.
* Partner directly with business service leaders and senior technology stakeholders.
* Create reusable CSM patterns that can scale across functions without creating unnecessary complexity.
* Influence the use of automation, data, analytics, knowledge, search, and AI within shared-services operations.
* Work within a mature ServiceNow platform organization alongside Product, Architecture, Engineering, UX, Enterprise AI, and Operations.

What You Will Do
  
  
Own the GBS+ Product Roadmap
  
  

* Own and maintain the ServiceNow product roadmap for GBS+ and the shared-services functions it supports.
* Work with business product managers, process owners, and service leaders to understand priorities, pain points, and expected outcomes.
* Turn business priorities into product capabilities, release plans, and a focused backlog.
* Maintain a clear view of committed work, new demand, dependencies, constraints, and risks.
* Balance the needs of individual functions with opportunities to build common capabilities across GBS+.
* Make clear recommendations on scope, sequencing, platform fit, and investment priorities.
* Keep the roadmap aligned with the broader ServiceNow strategy, architecture standards, and product direction.
* Communicate decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and expected outcomes in business terms.

Lead Case Management Across GBS+
  
  

* Set the product direction for case management across Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other shared-services functions.
* Establish common approaches for intake, categorization, assignment, routing, approvals, tasks, escalations, notifications, service commitments, resolution, closure, and feedback.
* Decide where teams should use a common case-management pattern and where a real business difference calls for a different approach.
* Prevent separate teams from creating duplicate case types, processes, data structures, or user experiences.
* Guide the design of case types, service definitions, assignment models, work queues, case tasks, entitlements, and SLAs.
* Make sure case-management designs provide clear ownership, traceability, operational visibility, and a consistent requester experience.
* Challenge requests that simply move an email process into ServiceNow without improving the service model.
* Look at the full request-to-resolution experience, not just the form or workflow being built.

Provide Strong CSM Product Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the product expert for ServiceNow Customer Service Management across GBS+.
* Guide the effective use of CSM case types, service definitions, workspaces, assignment, routing, entitlements, SLAs, knowledge, communications, and reporting.
* Evaluate requirements against native ServiceNow and CSM capabilities before supporting customization.
* Identify where existing CSM configurations and shared components can be reused or extended.
* Work with Architecture and Engineering when a requirement affects the CSM data model, security, integrations, performance, or support model.
* Stay current on relevant ServiceNow releases and bring practical recommendations into the roadmap.
* Manage the lifecycle of CSM capabilities, including introduction, adoption, enhancement, standardization, consolidation, and retirement.
* Help the business understand what ServiceNow can support, where tradeoffs exist, and when another solution may be a better fit.

Manage Demand and Backlog Priorities
  
  

* Establish a clear intake and evaluation process for GBS+ demand.
* Evaluate requests based on business value, user impact, urgency, strategic alignment, functional fit, dependencies, effort, and long-term support needs.
* Work with the Business Analyst to turn approved demand into clear epics, features, stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog that reflects agreed outcomes and available delivery capacity.

We are looking for candidates who share those values along with a genuine desire and drive to deliver top technology solutions to today's markets.
  
  
With this position we offer :
  
  
Join the Product organization within Nasdaq’s Data Platform & Operations Team. The main objective of our team is to deliver the foundational components of a new common data platform to integreate Nasdaq’s Capital Access Platform division. As our new member, you will work with a group of enthusiastic and experienced team members and colleagues. Together with your team, you will be responsible for delivery and support of product enhancements for our data platform foundation.
  
  
**Your role and responsibilities:**
The
**Product Delivery Specialist**
(Product Owner) represents business stakeholders to elicit, understand, analyze, document, refine and communicate business needs so that technical delivery teams can build effective solutions. This requires a detailed understanding of client needs, as well as business vision and strategy, to prioritize investment, business value and delivery. The ideal candidate must be able to work collaboratively as a fully contributing team member, under broad guidance from a Product Manager and a well-formed development team and performs essential tasks to support the team including requirements gathering, data analysis, product testing, issue management, meeting facilitation, and documentation. Besides working closely with your colleagues in Bangalore, you will also work closely with Nasdaq teams in other countries.
  
  
**Furthermore, you will:**

* Understand the business processes, story mapping, documenting detailed business requirements, developing functional designs, conducting gap analysis, etc. that bring the client and project team to a common understanding of the product and how it satisfies the business need
* Build and maintain the product backlog and elaborate user stories for implementation, working with the Product Manager to ensure alignment toward the business vision and strategy
* Operate in an Agile team environment and ensure success of the project by taking ownership of deliverables and performing agile project management, testing, support and training
* Inspect, accept or reject completed work from the development sprint
* Provide production support issue triage and facilitate timely resolution, adhering to acceptable quality thresholds
* Maintain open and constant communication amongst the team, management, and stakeholders regarding project status and sprint outcomes

**We expect you to have**

jobs.title: Product Owner, Workday, Talent & Performance
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
The
**Experienced Product Owner**
is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the Talent & Performance Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Talent & Performance end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to configure, test, validate and deploy.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Create design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Own day-to-day delivery.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role):**
Talent & Learning: Performance reviews, goal management, succession planning, learning campaigns, content management, and skills framework.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

**About Revantage**
Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
  
  
Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that…

jobs.title: Senior Qa Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Rasonix Private Limited is looking for a hands-on Senior QA Engineer who can independently own quality across web applications, APIs and mobile workflows. You will design effective test coverage, execute high-risk scenarios, maintain practical automation, investigate defects and partner with developers and stakeholders to deliver reliable releases. This is primarily an individual-contributor role, with coordination and mentoring responsibilities as needed.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

***Test strategy, execution and release quality***

* Review requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; identify gaps, edge cases, dependencies and test risks before development is complete.
* Prepare and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data and regression checklists; prioritize coverage by business impact.
* Perform functional, exploratory, integration, smoke, sanity, end-to-end, regression and UAT-support testing for web and Android/iOS applications.
* Validate critical business workflows such as search, forms, user accounts, permissions, checkout/payment flows and error handling, wherever applicable.
* Own defect reporting and retesting in Jira, including clear reproduction steps, evidence, impact, severity and verification of fixes.
* Assess release readiness, perform pre- and post-deployment smoke checks and communicate test status, open risks and release recommendations.

  

***Automation, API and data validation***

* Develop and maintain stable UI regression tests using Java and Selenium; apply sensible test structure, reusable components, assertions, waits and reporting.
* Test REST APIs using Postman or Bruno, covering authentication, response codes, payloads, negative cases, boundary conditions and API-to-UI consistency.
* Use SQL queries to validate data, state transitions and integration outcomes; work comfortably with joins, filters and basic data investigation.
* Run cross-browser, responsive and device testing using real devices and/or platforms such as BrowserStack or LambdaTest.
* Identify high-value automation opportunities, troubleshoot flaky tests and collaborate on running automated checks through CI/CD where available.

  

***Collaboration and continuous improvement***

* Work closely with developers, designers, product owners and clients to clarify issues, reproduce field-reported defects and manage testing priorities.
* Coordinate QA tasks and report progress in Jira when multiple testers are involved; support junior testers without losing hands-on ownership.
* Improve QA practices through root-cause analysis, defect-prevention feedback and practical tracking of coverage and escaped defects.

  

**Required qualifications and technical skills**

  

* 5 to 6 years of hands-on software testing experience, primarily on production web applications, with practical Android/iOS testing exposure.
* Strong understanding of the software testing life cycle (STLC), SDLC, Agile/Scrum delivery, test design techniques and defect life cycle.
* Demonstrable manual test design and execution skills, including integration, regression, exploratory and risk-based testing.
* Working experience with Java + Selenium automation; able to explain and improve existing frameworks, selectors, synchronization, assertions and maintainability (e.g., TestNG/JUnit, Page Object Model).
* Hands-on REST API testing with Postman or Bruno, along with working SQL knowledge for backend data verification.
* Comfortable with Jira, Git/Bitbucket, browser developer tools, defect evidence and clear written status reporting.
* Good troubleshooting skills, ownership, communication and the ability to collaborate directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  

**Preferred / advantageous experience**

  

* CI/CD integration for test automation, such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* Basic performance/load testing with JMeter or an equivalent tool, and interpreting latency, throughput and error trends.
* Mobile automation with Appium, or stronger experience testing native/hybrid Android and iOS applications.
* Exposure to e-commerce, payments, high-volume search, role-based access control or security-minded functional test scenarios.

  

**What success looks like**

  

* Own testing of assigned releases with well-understood risks, clear defect communication and reliable coverage of business-critical journeys.
* Maintain and progressively improve a focused automated regression suite that complements, rather than replaces, thoughtful manual testing.
* Help the team catch defects earlier, reduce repeat issues and make release decisions using visible evidence.

  

Rasonix Private Limited is an equal-opportunity employer. Selection is based on relevant skills, job-related experience and demonstrated capability.

The **EPR & Sustainability Reporting Analyst** will report with a dotted line to the Climate Reporting Controller based in the United States. ### **BI Analyst / BI Developer – Power BI, SQL & DAX (Remote, India)**

Gusti Leder is a German brand for natural leather goods, with retail stores in Germany and Austria, an online shop, and teams across Europe and India. We want every team—from the CEO to store managers—to make decisions from fast, clear, and trustworthy dashboards.

We are looking for our first dedicated BI specialist: someone who understands what colleagues really need from their data, helps us choose the right BI platform, builds a solid data model, and delivers dashboards people actually use.

### **What Matters Most to Us**

* **Numbers You Can Trust:** Totals that reconcile with our source systems, clear KPI definitions, and checks that catch problems before management does.
* **Understanding the Goal Behind a Request:** You look beyond the written requirement, understand how colleagues want to work with the data, and suggest better ways to answer their question.
* **Business Sense:** You think about cost, speed, and how a dashboard looks to a busy CEO—not only about the technology.
* **Ownership:** You take a report from requirement to rollout and keep it running.

### **Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Strategic Impact:** Become our first dedicated BI specialist, helping select our BI platform and building the reporting foundation for retail stores in Germany and Austria, our online shop, and leadership.
* **Stable, Overlapping Schedule:** Remote work from India with consistent weekday hours (12:30–21:30 IST) that give you at least 7 hours of live overlap with our technical lead in Germany.
* **Modern Data Stack & Growth:** Work directly with a MySQL-based data warehouse aggregating POS, ERP, e-commerce, and marketing data, supported by a dedicated learning budget (e.g., for Microsoft PL-300).
* **Clean, Documented BI Function:** Build a lasting data dictionary, clear KPI definitions, and self-help guides in our Outline knowledge base.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **BI Platform Evaluation**
* **What You Will Do:** Run a proof of concept on our real reports, compare options on licence and hosting cost, maintenance effort, performance with wide tables (50+ columns), and visual quality, and present a clear recommendation with a business case. Then set up the chosen tool.
* **Requirements & Business Partnering**
* **What You Will Do:** Work with management, marketing, finance, and stores to understand the goal behind each request (e.g., "how does ad spend on channel X change user behaviour Y?"), translate it into KPIs and data needs, and propose solutions—not just build what is written down.
* **Data Connections & Pipelines**
* **What You Will Do:** Connect our sources—our base is a MySQL-based data warehouse, with data aggregated from POS, ERP/warehouse systems, the online shop, Google Sheets, and finance files, with new sources added regularly—with scheduled refreshes and monitoring. Specify the structured data you need; our development team helps bring new sources into the warehouse.
* **Data Modelling & DAX**
* **What You Will Do:** Build star-schema models and DAX measures (contribution margin, sales, returns, stock, marketing performance) whose totals are correct at every level. Prepare the model so a move to Power BI is straightforward.

* **What You Will Do:** Check the data you work with for duplicates, inconsistent values, returns, and gaps; reconcile figures with the source systems; set up data-quality checks and flag issues to the data team.
* **Dashboards & Reports**
* **What You Will Do:** Design fast, readable dashboards for management and stores: wide tables with frozen columns, filters by date, country, SKU, and channel, drill-down, and Excel export.
* **Maintenance & Support**
* **What You Will Do:** Keep refreshes, connections, and access rights running; tune performance; manage versions and changes.
* **Documentation & Training**
* **What You Will Do:** Keep a data dictionary, KPI definitions, and how-to guides in our Outline knowledge base; train business users.
* **Presenting Insights**
* **What You Will Do:** Present findings and recommendations in simple English to colleagues in Germany.

### **Key Requirements**

* **Hands-On BI Experience:** 2–3 years of hands-on experience in BI or data analysis, building dashboards used in production, backed by a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or similar (or equivalent experience).
* **Power BI & Data Modelling:** Strong proficiency in DAX (CALCULATE, SUMX, time intelligence, context), Power Query, and star-schema data modelling.
* **SQL & Data Warehousing:** Solid SQL skills (joins, window functions, and CTEs) on a relational data warehouse (we use MySQL).
* **Requirements Thinking & Cost Awareness:** Ability to ask "what decision will this support?" and adapt reports to how people actually work, paired with familiarity with a second BI tool (e.g., Looker Studio, Metabase, Tableau, Superset, or Qlik) and understanding of BI licensing models (per user vs. capacity vs. open source) and maintenance costs.
* **Communication & Setup:** Clear written and spoken English, able to explain numbers to non-technical managers, plus your own laptop, a second monitor, and a stable internet connection.
* **Practical AI Usage:** Confident using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot) in your daily workflow to move faster—and critically reviewing the output rather than trusting it blindly. *(Bonus if you use AI coding assistants for SQL/DAX or LLM APIs in data automation.)*

* **Tracking & Marketing Data:** Experience with Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads, Google Ads metrics, attribution, and campaign performance.
* **Retail & E-Commerce KPIs:** Familiarity with retail or e-commerce metrics such as contribution margin, sell-through, and returns.

Employment Type: Full-Time

About AltEdge Manufacturing

AltEdge Manufacturing is a fast-growing, VC-backed component sourcing and manufacturing company in India, focused on custom metal manufacturing, including castings, forgings, and machined components.

We work with a network of Indian MSME manufacturing partners to serve customers across India, the USA, and Europe. Our key industries include infrastructure, mining, automotive, oil & gas, defence, and other high-end engineering sectors.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Business Operations Analyst to manage our end-to-end RFQ (Request for Quotation) process and support international business development through lead generation and outbound sales.

Key Responsibilities

1. RFQ Management

\* Review, mask, and redact customer drawings to remove confidential information using Adobe Acrobat, Nitro, or similar PDF tools.

\* Upload RFQs with accurate drawings, specifications, quantities, and supporting documents.

\* Maintain proper documentation, file naming, folder structures, and version control.

2. RFQ Tracking & Costing Coordination

\* Maintain and regularly update RFQ trackers with status, ownership, deadlines, and quotation values.

\* Coordinate with engineering and costing teams to ensure timely quotations.

\* Follow up on pending RFQs and highlight delays.

\* Track and report costing turnaround time (TAT) and other operational metrics.

3. Lead Generation & Database Management

\* Research and build international lead databases using trade data, LinkedIn, industry directories, and other sources.

\* Extract, clean, filter, and maintain accurate contact information.

\* Segment leads based on geography, industry, and component requirements.

\* Avoid duplicate entries and ensure database accuracy.

4. International Sales & Outbound Calling

\* Make 50–100 outbound calls daily to international prospects across the USA, Europe, and other markets.

\* Introduce AltEdge Manufacturing and its products and services.

\* Understand customer requirements and identify potential business opportunities.

\* Generate qualified leads, meetings, and RFQ opportunities.

\* Record calls, follow-ups, and outcomes in the CRM or sales tracker.

\* Coordinate with the Business Development team to hand over qualified leads.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education

\* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.

Experience

\* 0–3 years of relevant experience.

\* Freshers with good internships in manufacturing, sales, or operations can also apply.

Technical Skills

\* Basic understanding of 2D engineering drawings.

\* Knowledge of manufacturing processes such as casting, forging, and machining.

\* Working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat, Nitro, or similar PDF editing tools.

\* Good command of MS Excel and Google Sheets.

\* Basic understanding of CRM tools and lead management.

Communication & Personal Skills

\* Good spoken and written English communication.

\* Comfortable speaking with international customers.

\* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.

\* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

\* Confidence and resilience in handling high-volume outbound calls.

\* Strong ownership and willingness to learn.

Good to Have

\* Exposure to RFQ management, estimation, or costing.

\* Experience in cold calling, inside sales, or international business development.

\* Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and lead-generation databases.

What We Offer

\* Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, VC-backed manufacturing company.

\* Exposure to international customers and global markets.

\* Hands-on experience across engineering, manufacturing operations, and sales.

\* Opportunity to work closely with engineering, costing, and business development teams.

\* Learning and career growth opportunities, with a potential career path into international business development.

Who Should Apply?

This role is ideal for a mechanical engineering graduate or diploma holder who is interested in combining technical engineering knowledge, business operations, and international sales.

Apply Now: If you are detail-oriented, confident in communication, and interested in building a career in manufacturing operations and global sales, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹200,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, clinical teams, product owners, data engineers, and technology teams to deliver data-driven solutions while supporting AI and Generative AI initiatives within clinical and research environments.

* Gather, analyze, validate, and document business and functional requirements from clinical, operational, and technology stakeholders.

* Develop Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), User Stories, Use Cases, Process Flows, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops, discovery sessions, and requirements elicitation activities.

jobs.description:
### **BI Analyst / BI Developer – Power BI, SQL & DAX (Remote, India)**

Gusti Leder is a German brand for natural leather goods, with retail stores in Germany and Austria, an online shop, and teams across Europe and India. We want every team—from the CEO to store managers—to make decisions from fast, clear, and trustworthy dashboards.

We are looking for our first dedicated BI specialist: someone who understands what colleagues really need from their data, helps us choose the right BI platform, builds a solid data model, and delivers dashboards people actually use.

### **What Matters Most to Us**

* **Numbers You Can Trust:** Totals that reconcile with our source systems, clear KPI definitions, and checks that catch problems before management does.
* **Understanding the Goal Behind a Request:** You look beyond the written requirement, understand how colleagues want to work with the data, and suggest better ways to answer their question.
* **Business Sense:** You think about cost, speed, and how a dashboard looks to a busy CEO—not only about the technology.
* **Ownership:** You take a report from requirement to rollout and keep it running.

### **Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Strategic Impact:** Become our first dedicated BI specialist, helping select our BI platform and building the reporting foundation for retail stores in Germany and Austria, our online shop, and leadership.
* **Stable, Overlapping Schedule:** Remote work from India with consistent weekday hours (12:30–21:30 IST) that give you at least 7 hours of live overlap with our technical lead in Germany.
* **Modern Data Stack & Growth:** Work directly with a MySQL-based data warehouse aggregating POS, ERP, e-commerce, and marketing data, supported by a dedicated learning budget (e.g., for Microsoft PL-300).
* **Clean, Documented BI Function:** Build a lasting data dictionary, clear KPI definitions, and self-help guides in our Outline knowledge base.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **BI Platform Evaluation**
* **What You Will Do:** Run a proof of concept on our real reports, compare options on licence and hosting cost, maintenance effort, performance with wide tables (50+ columns), and visual quality, and present a clear recommendation with a business case. Then set up the chosen tool.
* **Requirements & Business Partnering**
* **What You Will Do:** Work with management, marketing, finance, and stores to understand the goal behind each request (e.g., "how does ad spend on channel X change user behaviour Y?"), translate it into KPIs and data needs, and propose solutions—not just build what is written down.
* **Data Connections & Pipelines**
* **What You Will Do:** Connect our sources—our base is a MySQL-based data warehouse, with data aggregated from POS, ERP/warehouse systems, the online shop, Google Sheets, and finance files, with new sources added regularly—with scheduled refreshes and monitoring. Specify the structured data you need; our development team helps bring new sources into the warehouse.
* **Data Modelling & DAX**
* **What You Will Do:** Build star-schema models and DAX measures (contribution margin, sales, returns, stock, marketing performance) whose totals are correct at every level. Prepare the model so a move to Power BI is straightforward.
* **Data Validation & Quality**
* **What You Will Do:** Check the data you work with for duplicates, inconsistent values, returns, and gaps; reconcile figures with the source systems; set up data-quality checks and flag issues to the data team.
* **Dashboards & Reports**
* **What You Will Do:** Design fast, readable dashboards for management and stores: wide tables with frozen columns, filters by date, country, SKU, and channel, drill-down, and Excel export.
* **Maintenance & Support**
* **What You Will Do:** Keep refreshes, connections, and access rights running; tune performance; manage versions and changes.
* **Documentation & Training**
* **What You Will Do:** Keep a data dictionary, KPI definitions, and how-to guides in our Outline knowledge base; train business users.
* **Presenting Insights**
* **What You Will Do:** Present findings and recommendations in simple English to colleagues in Germany.

### **Key Requirements**

* **Hands-On BI Experience:** 2–3 years of hands-on experience in BI or data analysis, building dashboards used in production, backed by a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or similar (or equivalent experience).
* **Power BI & Data Modelling:** Strong proficiency in DAX (CALCULATE, SUMX, time intelligence, context), Power Query, and star-schema data modelling.
* **SQL & Data Warehousing:** Solid SQL skills (joins, window functions, and CTEs) on a relational data warehouse (we use MySQL).
* **Requirements Thinking & Cost Awareness:** Ability to ask "what decision will this support?" and adapt reports to how people actually work, paired with familiarity with a second BI tool (e.g., Looker Studio, Metabase, Tableau, Superset, or Qlik) and understanding of BI licensing models (per user vs. capacity vs. open source) and maintenance costs.
* **Communication & Setup:** Clear written and spoken English, able to explain numbers to non-technical managers, plus your own laptop, a second monitor, and a stable internet connection.
* **Practical AI Usage:** Confident using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot) in your daily workflow to move faster—and critically reviewing the output rather than trusting it blindly. *(Bonus if you use AI coding assistants for SQL/DAX or LLM APIs in data automation.)*

### **✨ Nice to Have**

* **Tracking & Marketing Data:** Experience with Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads, Google Ads metrics, attribution, and campaign performance.
* **Retail & E-Commerce KPIs:** Familiarity with retail or e-commerce metrics such as contribution margin, sell-through, and returns.
* **Database & Analytics Tooling:** MySQL performance and data-warehouse modelling, Python (pandas) or similar for analysis and aut…

**Job Title**

Product Definition Analyst

**Summary of the Role**
-----------------------

  

Join the Travel Distribution (TRD) Artificial Intelligence (AI) organization and help shape the next generation of AI-powered travel distribution products.

As a Product Definition Analyst (PDA), you’ll connect business and technical stakeholders, understand user and business needs, and translate them into clear product capabilities. You’ll work closely with Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, and AI specialists to develop solutions that are valuable for users, aligned with business needs, and sustainable over time.

**In This Role You’ll / Your Main Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------------

  

* **Understand user and business needs:** Collaborate with customers, business stakeholders, and product teams to understand user journeys, processes, challenges, and opportunities, and translate these insights into clear functional requirements and expected outcomes.
* **Define product capabilities and experiences:** Create user stories, business rules, workflows, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications, while designing end-to-end experiences that are understandable, testable, and maintainable.
* **Contribute to AI-enabled solutions:** Explore how technologies such as Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI), AI agents, and intelligent automation can address user and business needs, and define the functional requirements that support their responsible integration into products.
* **Support delivery and validation:** Work with Agile software development teams throughout the product lifecycle to clarify requirements, support implementation, validate delivered functionality against agreed expectations, and contribute to resolving functional issues.
* **Connect teams and share knowledge:** Work across Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, Operations, and business teams to maintain a shared understanding of product goals, provide functional expertise, maintain relevant documentation, and contribute to continuous product improvement.

  

**About the Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------------

  

You’ll be a good fit for this role if you bring relevant experience and enjoy working across business, technology, and user needs. We encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every aspect listed below.

* Experience in Product Definition, Functional Analysis, Business Analysis, or a related role, including translating business needs into clear product requirements or specifications.
* Experience working with Agile software development teams, with knowledge of areas such as requirements elicitation, user stories, functional specifications, business process modelling, functional design, Scrum methodologies, or product lifecycle management.
* Understanding of technical concepts relevant to digital products, including Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and data integration, with an interest in developing your understanding of AI-enabled products and workflows.
* Effective problem-solving, critical-thinking, communication, and facilitation skills, including the ability to simplify complex topics, organize information clearly, and work effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to understand customer needs and collaborate across teams, together with an interest in learning and applying new approaches. Experience in the travel search or shopping domain can help you get started in the role, but candidates with relevant experience from other domains are also encouraged to apply.

**What We Can Offer You**
-------------------------

* A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you'll power the future of travel with a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.
* A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
* Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, from on-the-job training to formal activities and daily interactions.
* A caring environment – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.
* A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive compensation packages, including salary, bonus, caregiving and health benefits.
* A flexible working model - Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best.
* A diverse, equitable, and inclusive community – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment.
* A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

Job Description

**Industrial Engineer**

Cutting, Logistics, Stores & Aluminium Hardware Fabrication Operational

**Position at a Glance**

**Field Details**  
**Job title** Industrial Engineer Cutting, Logistics, Stores & Aluminium Hardware Fabrication

**Department**Operational Excellence

**Grade / level**Executive / Engineer

**Reports to**Sr. Manager Industrial Engineering

**Function head** Ops Excellence Head (Rajesh Makwana)

**Direct reports** None (individual contributor)

**Area of deployment** Cutting & sorting operations, Logistics, Stores and Aluminium Hardware fabrication

**Location** Group Bayport manufacturing plant(s)

**Employment type** Full-time, Permanent

**Experience required**

3–8 years

**CTC band** 4,00,000 – 7,00,000 per annum, based on experience

**Job Purpose**

The Industrial Engineer owns plant-area Industrial Engineering for Group Bayport’s cutting and sorting operations, Logistics, Stores and Aluminium Hardware fabrication, and reports to the Sr. Manager – Industrial Engineering.The role delivers time and motion studies, line balancing, layout improvement and scrap containment for these areas. It is also the primary shop-floor partner as CNC and cutting-related automation is commissioned.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Time & Motion Studies**

* Conduct time studies (SAM / MOST / stopwatch) on manual and CNC cutting operations, Logistics, Stores, and Aluminium Hardware cutting and bending.
* Validate area process times against field data before they are proposed as standard, and feed signed-off entries into the Departmental SAM Catalog.
* Set and maintain Takt Time for cutting, Logistics, Stores and hardware lines against current demand.

**2. Layout, Flow & Line Balancing**

* Map material delivery routes from fabric and foam rolls through to the cutting tables; identify and remove flow bottlenecks.
* Balance manning and workstation layout on cutting and hardware lines against Takt Time.
* Execute SMED / quick-changeover initiatives on cutting equipment, roll change and hardware tooling, as directed by the Sr. Manager – IE.

**3. Scrap Containment & Visual Management**

* Own the nesting and cutting scrap KPI for the area; implement and maintain scrap tracking boards at each cutting station.
* Introduce Poka-Yoke (mistake-proofing) where scrap is systemic rather than one-off.
* Implement hourly production tracking boards for the area, in coordination with the BPM Team.

**4. Automation Partnership**

* Act as the shop-floor point of contact for CNC and laser-cutting automation projects owned by the Manager, Automation & Business Analyst.
* Validate manual-vs-automated cycle time and scrap assumptions before and after commissioning, and feed post-commissioning variance data back into the automation portfolio’s tracking.

**5. BOM & Cross-Functional Support**

* Support the MDM Team on BOM-linked time measurement (crew size, labour and machine calculation) for cutting and hardware SKUs.
* Coordinate with the peer Industrial Engineer (BB, Tarps & Stores), and escalate capacity-impacting findings to the Sr. Manager – IE and the Manager – Global Capacity.

**Qualifications & Experience**

The role needs an engineering diploma or degree plus 3–8 years of apparel manufacturing experience.

**Essential**

* Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Industrial, Apparel, Textile, Mechanical or Production Engineering.
* 3–8 years of experience in apparel manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of time and motion study methods (SAM / MOST / stopwatch).
* Comfortable working across the production floor.
* Working proficiency in Excel.

**Preferred**

* Exposure to stitching, signage, print or banner production operations.

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Shop-floor first:** a hands-on problem solver who is comfortable working directly on the floor.
* **Layout and flow:** organised, with a strong eye for layout and material flow.
* **Data discipline:** accurate, disciplined data collection; time studies are run to a standard, not an approximation.
* **Collaboration:** works cleanly with the Sr. Manager – IE, the peer plant-area IE, the MDM Team and the BPM Team.

jobs.description:
**Title**

Our corporate activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time Associate Clinical Data Manager to join our Data Management team in our Mumbai office. This position will work in a team to accomplish tasks and projects that are instrumental to the company’s success. If you want an exciting career where you use your previous expertise and can develop and grow your career even further, then this is the opportunity for you.

**Overview**

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain Data Management Plan
* Oversee development and maintenance of CRF specifications, CRF completion guidelines, edit check specifications, and external database specifications
* Oversee EDC design, development, validation
* Manage multiple projects, timelines, and Data Management teams to ensure quality and timely deliverables
* Develop project metrics and reports to support data-driven decision-making
* Represent Data Management in sponsor meetings and cross-functional discussions
* Coordinate overall Data Management by serving as the primary contact for the Sponsor, external data providers and all project team members

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of clinical Data Management experience, including managing multiple clinical projects and serving as the primary sponsor contact.
* Prior experience in line management, team and project leadership, and Data Management deliverables
* Strong understanding of clinical Data Management processes, database structures, and clinical research methodologies.
* Proficiency with EDC, Excel, and data analysis tools (experience with Rave or SAS preferred)
* Working knowledge of medical terminology and clinical research concepts

People. Purpose. Passion. Make a Difference Tomorrow. Join Us Today.

The work we’ve done over the past 30+ years has positively impacted the lives of countless patients and families who face hundreds of diseases across all key therapeutic areas. The work we do today will improve the lives of people living with illness and disease in the future.

**Medpace Perks**

* Flexible work environment
* Competitive compensation and benefits package
* Competitive PTO packages
* Structured career paths with opportunities for professional growth
* Company-sponsored employee appreciation events
* Employee health and wellness initiatives

**Awards**

* Recognized by Forbes as one of America's Most Successful Midsize Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024
* Continually recognized with CRO Leadership Awards from Life Science Leader magazine based on expertise, quality, capabilities, reliability, and compatibility

**What to Expect Next**

A Medpace team member will review your qualifications and, if interested, you will be contacted with details for next steps.

jobs.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

The Business Analyst and Tester is responsible for business analysis and quality assurance activities across reporting, Salesforce, and connected applications within the Business Operations function at LLI. The successful candidate will be a business-minded technology professional with excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and delivery skills. The role combines end-to-end business analysis with hands-on quality assurance, ensuring business requirements are clearly defined, solutions are delivered to meet business needs, and changes are thoroughly tested before release. The position is responsible for owning the requirements lifecycle, from engaging stakeholders to understand business needs through to creating detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and test scenarios for developers and delivery teams. The role is also responsible for planning and executing QA testing activities, coordinating user acceptance testing, identifying and managing defects, and ensuring solutions are thoroughly tested, accepted by users, and aligned to business priorities before release.

**Business Analyst Responsibilities:**

* Own requirements gathering for reporting, Salesforce, and connected applications, working closely with stakeholders to understand business problems, priorities, and desired outcomes.
* Translate business requirements into clear, actionable user stories and requirements, ensuring solutions align with architecture and platform principles across Salesforce, Snowflake, Power BI, and connected applications. Ensure scope, dependencies, and success measures are clearly defined and understood.
* Create detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and supporting documentation that enable effective delivery across reporting, Salesforce, and operational systems.
* Develop a deep understanding of how the business operates, including commercial, customer, product, reporting, and operational processes, to ensure solutions are practical and business-led.
* Champion agile ways of working, supporting effective backlog management, sprint planning, prioritisation, refinement, and continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Collaborate with developers, platform owners, product stakeholders, and data teams on solution design, feasibility, estimations, and delivery planning.
* Support stakeholder engagement throughout the delivery lifecycle, ensuring requirements remain visible, changes are appropriately managed, and delivered solutions meet business needs.

  

**QA / Testing Responsibilities:**

  

* Analyse requirements and user stories to develop robust testing scenarios, including functional, integration, regression, and edge-case testing across reporting, Salesforce, and connected applications.
* Execute structured QA prior to full user acceptance testing, identifying defects, gaps, and risks before changes are released to business users.
* Provide clear, timely feedback to developers to ensure all acceptance criteria, business rules, and quality standards are met.
* Create and maintain test plans, test scripts, test evidence, defect logs, and retest results in a consistent and auditable manner.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders during UAT, helping users understand test objectives, expected outcomes, and any known limitations.
* Validate data, reporting outputs, Salesforce configuration, workflows, and connected application changes to ensure they operate as expected across end-to-end user journeys.
* Support release readiness by confirming defects have been resolved, regression testing has been completed, and business acceptance is appropriately captured.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA and testing practices, helping to improve consistency, coverage, and confidence in business operations solutions.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst with hands-on QA and testing responsibilities across Salesforce, reporting platforms, and related business applications.
* Strong experience gathering requirements, creating user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting delivery through agile ways of working.
* Experience planning and executing QA and testing activities, including test scenario development, defect management, regression testing, and UAT coordination.
* Understanding of Salesforce data models, processes, workflows, and platform capabilities, with the ability to translate business requirements into effective Salesforce solutions.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake, Power BI, Adobe Analytics, and connected business applications, with the ability to translate business requirements into reporting and data solutions.
* Experience analysing and documenting business processes, workflows, and operational requirements.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage business users, developers, and technology stakeholders effectively.
* Ability to understand complex system landscapes and assess the impact of changes across Salesforce, reporting platforms, data systems, and connected applications.

About the Role

  

We're hiring a Murex Sourcing Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team at Bounteous. You'll be a hands-on individual contributor focused on finding, screening, and qualifying specialized Murex talent. You'll own your pipelines end to end, from first search through to a qualified shortlist, and you'll work closely with the team lead and client stakeholders on requirements.

  

What You'll Own

Your work centers on sourcing and qualifying Murex professionals across Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, and supporting domains. You'll build your own candidate pipelines, verify technical claims, and deliver shortlists that hiring managers can trust. You'll also keep requirement documentation accurate so searches stay aligned with what the client actually needs.

  

The Role at a Glance

* Build and maintain passive candidate pipelines for assigned requisitions using LinkedIn, Boolean search, and professional networks
* Screen candidates for genuine Murex experience, distinguishing people who have delivered Murex work from those who only list keywords
* Source across Front Office (derivatives, FX, rates, trading), Middle Office (integration, controls), Back Office (settlements, reconciliations), and support functions
* Source for roles including Murex Consultants, Business Analysts, Support specialists, and Market Risk professionals
* Identify and flag fake or inflated profiles before they reach hiring managers
* Build relationships with active and passive candidates, and keep promising rejected candidates warm for future referrals
* Document requirements and sourcing criteria in writing, and confirm them with the team lead before starting a search
* Give structured feedback to the team lead when candidates miss expectations, and adjust search strategy based on that feedback
* Track your pipeline, submissions, and conversion metrics in the ATS

Who We're Looking For

  

**Must Have:**

* 2 to 7 years of experience in talent acquisition or technical recruitment, with sourcing as a core part of the role
* Working knowledge of at least one or two Murex modules, and understanding of the roles and skill requirements around them
* Hands-on sourcing experience, including Boolean search and LinkedIn Recruiter (or equivalent) for passive candidates
* Ability to tell real domain experience from keyword-stuffed profiles, using screening questions and basic technical validation
* Familiarity with financial services domains, including trading, risk, operations, or settlements
* Strong written documentation habits: clear requirement notes, accurate candidate summaries, and tidy ATS records
* Comfortable working with clients or hiring managers on requirement clarification, under the guidance of a team lead
* Familiarity with AI-assisted recruiting tools and modern sourcing platforms

  

**Nice to Have:**

* Prior experience sourcing for Murex or other capital markets technology roles
* Experience across multiple geographies or clients
* Exposure to market risk, treasury, or back-office operations
* Experience with applicant tracking systems and sourcing automation tools
